definition_en: bending or twisting into curves and loops instead of lying straight
core_image: 一绺刚被热铁卷过的头发，绕成一个个小圈
scene: 镜子里，小姑娘额前的头发绕成一个个小圈。Her curly hair fell across her eyes.
sceneCN: 这里 curly 指「卷曲的」（第 1 个义项：头发弯成圈）；句意是她卷曲的头发垂到眼睛上。

senses.title: Twisted into rings
senses.definition: growing or shaped in rings rather than lying straight
senses.definitionCN: 长成或做成圈状，而不是直直地垂着
senses.example: She has thick curly hair and a quick smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一头浓密的卷发，笑起来很快。
senses.why: Straight is the default; a ring is a choice the strand makes.
senses.whyCN: 顺直是默认状态，绕成圈是发丝自己做的选择。

senses.title: Bent like a spring
senses.definition: curved into a spiral, as a tail or a tendril
senses.definitionCN: 弯成螺旋状，如尾巴或卷须
senses.example: The little pig ran past with a curly tail.
senses.exampleCN: 小猪翘着卷尾巴跑了过去。
senses.why: A coil stores length in a small space, out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 螺旋把长度收进一小块地方，谁也看不见。

senses.title: Turning at the edge
senses.definition: having an edge that curls over on itself
senses.definitionCN: 边缘向自身卷起的
senses.example: The old poster was curly at the corners.
senses.exampleCN: 那张旧海报的角都卷起来了。
senses.why: Paper and cloth remember the bend they were given.
senses.whyCN: 纸和布会记住别人给过它的那道弯。

intro.en: Curly is curl plus -y; curl came into English from Middle Dutch krul, a ringlet, in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: curly 由 curl 加后缀 -y 构成；curl 在十六世纪从荷兰语 krul（小卷）进入英语。

items.en: Krul named a lock of hair twisted into a ring.
items.cn: krul 指一绺绕成圈的发。

items.en: Curl entered English for hair that coils instead of hanging.
items.cn: curl 进入英语，指不垂下而是绕起来的头发。

items.en: The noun curl named a single ringlet of hair.
items.cn: 名词 curl 指单独一绺卷发。

items.en: The suffix -y turned such nouns into adjectives.
items.cn: 后缀 -y 把这类名词变成形容词。

items.en: Curly spread to tails, leaves, ribbons, and printed brackets.
items.cn: curly 后来扩展到尾巴、叶子、丝带和打印的括号。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening, and the meaning group names other ways of being bent.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 开头，近义组列出其他表示弯曲的说法。

entries.definition: a coil or ring of hair
to turn milk sour and thick
a wading bird with a long curved bill
entries.definitionCN: 一种长着弯长嘴的涉禽

entries.definition: having soft curves in place of straight lines
entries.definitionCN: 以柔和弧线代替直线的

entries.definition: wound round and round in a ring
bent by being turned at both ends

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with hair wound into a ring and end with edges that refuse to stay flat.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从绕成圈的头发开始，落到不肯服帖的边角上。

normal.en: Curly hair keeps the shape of the hand that wound it.
normal.cn: 卷发会记住绕它的那只手的形状。

normal.en: A curly tail is a spring the animal carries with it.
normal.cn: 卷尾巴是动物随身带着的一根弹簧。

normal.en: Curly brackets hold words the way two arms hold a box.
normal.cn: 花括号抱住词，就像两条手臂抱住一个盒子。

normal.en: Run a blade along a ribbon and it goes curly.
normal.cn: 用刀背一划丝带，它就卷起来了。

normal.en: If it loops instead of falling straight, call it curly.
normal.cn: 如果它绕圈而不是直直落下，就叫它卷曲。

abstract.en: Picture a lock of hair wound round a finger.
abstract.cn: 想象一绺头发绕在手指上。

abstract.en: Picture the curled corner of a poster that has hung too long.
abstract.cn: 想象挂了太久的旧海报，角已经翘起来。

abstract.en: Picture a pig tail turned into a small question mark.
abstract.cn: 想象猪尾巴弯成一个小小的问号。

examples.en: She has thick curly hair and a quick smile.
examples.cn: 她有一头浓密的卷发，笑起来很快。

examples.en: The ribbon went curly after the scissors ran over it.
examples.cn: 剪刀一划，丝带就卷起来了。

examples.en: His handwriting is small and curly.
examples.cn: 他的字又小又卷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curly 记成「卷」：curl 是一绺卷发，加上 -y 就成了「卷着的」。

root: 由 curl 加后缀 -y 构成；curl 在十六世纪从荷兰语 krul（小卷）进入英语，本义是一绺绕成圈的头发，后来泛指一切蜷曲的形状。

sensesIntro.en: From hair that loops, to tails that coil, to edges that turn over.
sensesIntro.cn: 从绕圈的头发，到盘起的尾巴，再到翘起的边角。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lock of hair wound into a small ring.
core.cn: 核心意象：一绺绕成小圈的头发。

branches.en: Hair that loops instead of falling is the first picture.
branches.cn: 不垂落而绕圈的头发，是这个词的第一幅画面。

branches.en: The same coil appears in a pig tail or a plant tendril.
branches.cn: 同样的盘绕也出现在猪尾巴和植物卷须上。

branches.en: Thin flat things curl at the edge when they dry or bend.
branches.cn: 薄的平东西干了或弯了，边就会翘起来。

branches.en: Hair and tails share one shape, a ring held in place.
branches.cn: 头发和尾巴共享一种形状，一个固定住的圈。

branches.en: A coil and a turned edge are both curved back on themselves.
branches.cn: 盘成的圈和翘起的边，都是朝自身弯回去的。

intro.en: Curly belongs to the curl family, where one small ring of hair grows into many bent things.
intro.cn: curly 属于 curl 这一族，一圈小卷发后来长成许多弯着的东西。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root stands behind this word; it came from Dutch krul, a ringlet.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词背后没有拉丁词根，它来自荷兰语 krul（小卷）。

items.example: The child had curly hair.
She curled her hair with a hot iron.
The curlers sat in a box.

items.example: A curly-haired boy waved at us.
items.exampleCN: 一个卷发男孩朝我们挥手。

The cat slept with its tail curled.

items.meaning: the sport of sliding stones on ice

items.exampleCN: 冰壶在寒冷国家很流行。

items.meaning: to lie with the body bent
items.example: He curled up under a blanket.
Write the set in curly brackets.
items.exampleCN: 把这个集合写在花括号里。

definition_en: the money a country uses, or the state of being widely used and believed
core_image: 柜台上摊开几张颜色各异的纸币，图案各不相同
scene: 换汇窗口前，一叠不同颜色的纸币被推到玻璃下面。She changed her currency before the flight.
sceneCN: 这里 currency 指「货币」（第 1 个义项：一国使用的钱）；句意是她在登机前兑换了货币。

senses.title: National money
senses.definition: the system of money that a country uses
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家所使用的货币制度
senses.example: The euro is the currency of many countries.
senses.exampleCN: 欧元是许多国家的货币。
senses.why: A country prints its own trust and asks others to accept it.
senses.whyCN: 一个国家印出自己的信用，再请别人接受它。

senses.title: Notes and coins
senses.definition: coins and paper notes used as a medium of exchange
senses.definitionCN: 用作交换媒介的硬币与纸币
senses.example: Foreign currency can be changed at the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 外币可以在那个柜台兑换。
senses.why: Value must take a form you can hand to another person.
senses.whyCN: 价值总得变成一种能递到别人手里的东西。

senses.title: Wide acceptance
senses.definition: the state of being widely used, repeated, or believed
senses.definitionCN: 被广泛使用、传述或相信的状态
senses.example: The rumour gained currency within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 那个传言一周之内就传开了。
senses.why: An idea becomes solid once many mouths carry it.
senses.whyCN: 一个想法被许多张嘴带着走，就变得实在了。

intro.en: Currency comes from Latin currere, to run, through the English word current and the suffix -cy.
intro.cn: currency 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），经英语 current 加后缀 -cy 构成。

items.en: Currere meant to run, as water runs in a channel.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，就像水在河道里流。

items.en: Currens described what is running or flowing.
items.cn: currens 形容正在跑、正在流的东西。

items.en: Current first named the running flow of a river.
items.cn: current 最初指河水奔流。

items.en: Currency named the state of being in use or accepted.
items.cn: currency 指被使用、被接受的状态。

items.en: The word settled on the money that passes from hand to hand.
items.cn: 这个词最终落在人与人之间传递的钱上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names what people pay with.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curr- 词干，近义组列出人们用来付钱的东西。

entries.definition: happening or flowing now
entries.definitionCN: 现在正在发生或流动的

entries.definition: a small dried grape used in baking
at the present time
coins and notes used to buy things
entries.definitionCN: 用来买东西的硬币和纸币

entries.definition: money in notes and coins, not in a bank
something offered as a means of payment
entries.definitionCN: 作为支付手段提供的东西

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with paper money leaving a hand and end with a rumour that will not stop travelling.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张离开手的纸币开始，落到一个停不下来的传言。

normal.en: Currency is value that keeps running between hands.
normal.cn: 货币就是在人与人之间不停跑动的价值。

normal.en: A note is only paper until a country says otherwise.
normal.cn: 纸币本来只是纸，直到国家开口赋予它意义。

normal.en: The same word covers money and rumour, because both circulate.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指钱又指传言，因为两者都在流通。

normal.en: When a saying gains currency, it starts to be spent like coins.
normal.cn: 一句话开始流行，就像硬币一样被花出去。

normal.en: Foreign currency is someone else's printed trust.
normal.cn: 外币，是别人印出来的信用。

abstract.en: Picture a banknote moving from one warm hand to another.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸币从一只温热的手传到另一只。

abstract.en: Picture coins crossing a border in a small cloth bag.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币装在小布袋里越过边境。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence repeated in every kitchen until it sounds true.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话在每个厨房里被重复，直到听起来像真的。

examples.en: The local currency is the yuan.
examples.cn: 当地货币是元。

examples.en: Old sayings can gain currency again.
examples.cn: 老话也能重新流行起来。

examples.en: She kept some foreign currency for the trip.
examples.cn: 她为这次旅行留了一些外币。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 currency 记成「正在跑的钱」：curr 是跑，-ency 是状态，钱在人手之间跑来跑去，就是货币。

root: 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），经古法语与英语 current 加后缀 -cy 构成；本义是「流动之物」，先指河水，后指流通中的钱，再指流传的说法。

sensesIntro.en: From the money a nation prints, to the notes in your hand, to an idea that circulates.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一国印出的钱，到手里的一张纸币，再到一个四处流传的想法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: paper money passing from one hand to the next.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张纸币从一只手传到另一只手。

branches.en: A state declares what counts as money inside its borders.
branches.cn: 国家宣布在它的边界内什么算钱。

branches.en: Notes and coins are the physical form that value takes.
branches.cn: 纸币和硬币，是价值采取的具体形状。

branches.en: An idea that everyone repeats is said to have currency.
branches.cn: 人人都在重复的想法，就被说成「通行」。

branches.en: The money of a country and the notes in your pocket are one system.
branches.cn: 一国的货币和口袋里的纸币，是同一套东西。

branches.en: What circulates is trusted, whether it is a note or a rumour.
branches.cn: 凡是流通的都被信任，不管是纸币还是传言。

intro.en: Currency sits in the curr- family, where the idea of running grows into money and into words on everyone's lips.
intro.cn: currency 属于 curr- 这一族，「跑」的意思长成了钱，也长成了人人嘴边的话。

latinIntro.en: The Latin currere, to run, is the root under current, currency, and recur.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）是 current、currency 与 recur 共同的根。

definition_zh: 当前的；现行的；水流；气流；电流
definition_en: happening or existing now, or a continuous flow of water, air, or electricity
core_image: 河水贴着石岸不停向前推，表面却看不出在动
scene: 河中央的水一刻不停地把木筏往下游推。The current pulled the raft downstream.
sceneCN: 这里 current 指「水流」（第 1 个义项：水的流动）；句意是水流把木筏往下游拖。

senses.title: Flowing water or air
senses.definition: a continuous flow of water or air in one direction
senses.definitionCN: 水或空气朝一个方向持续流动
senses.example: A strong current runs under the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 桥下有一股强劲的水流。
senses.why: Water in motion carries whatever floats on it.
senses.whyCN: 流动的水会带走漂浮在它上面的一切。

senses.title: Electric flow
senses.definition: the flow of electric charge through a wire or circuit
senses.definitionCN: 电荷在导线或电路中的流动
senses.example: The current was cut for two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 电流被切断了两个小时。
senses.why: Electricity behaves like water, so it borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 电的行为像水，于是借用了同一个词。

senses.title: Happening now
senses.definition: existing or happening at the present time
senses.definitionCN: 在当前时刻存在或发生的
senses.example: The current price is too high for us.
senses.exampleCN: 目前的价格对我们来说太高了。
senses.why: What is running now is the version that counts today.
senses.whyCN: 此刻正在跑的，才是今天算数的那一版。

intro.en: Current comes from Latin currere, to run, through Old French corant, running.
intro.cn: current 源自拉丁语 currere（跑），经古法语 corant（正在跑的）进入英语。

items.en: Currere meant to run, and water was said to run.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，水也被说成在跑。

items.en: Currens described anything in motion or in use.
items.cn: currens 形容一切在动、在用的东西。

items.en: Corant named the running flow of a stream.
items.cn: corant 指溪流奔涌的水。

items.en: Current entered English for moving water and moving time.
items.cn: current 进入英语，既指流动的水，也指流动的时间。

items.en: Science gave the word to electricity in a wire.
items.cn: 科学把这个词用到了导线里的电上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names things that exist at this time.

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a river pushing a raft and end with the price on today's tag.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从推着木筏的河水开始，落到今天标签上的价格。

normal.en: A current carries what floats, without asking.
normal.cn: 水流带走漂浮的东西，从不事先询问。

normal.en: Electricity borrowed the word because it also runs.

normal.en: The current price is merely the one running at this hour.

normal.en: If it is happening now, it is current.

branches.en: The first picture is water moving in one direction.

branches.en: Electric charge moves in the same way, so it takes the same name.

senses.title: In this period

senses.definitionCN: 与过去相对而言的当前时期
senses.example: The town is currently much quieter.
senses.exampleCN: 这个镇子如今安静多了。
senses.why: Calling something current sets it beside what came before.
senses.whyCN: 说某件事是当前的，就是把它放在从前旁边比较。

senses.title: For the time being
senses.definition: as things stand now, until something changes
senses.definitionCN: 按目前情况而言，直到有变化为止
senses.example: The library is currently closed for repairs.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆暂时因维修关闭。
senses.why: A temporary state is still the state that counts right now.
senses.whyCN: 暂时状态，仍是此刻算数的状态。

intro.en: Currently is current plus -ly; current itself comes from Latin currere, to run.
intro.cn: currently 由 current 加后缀 -ly 构成；current 出自拉丁语 currere（跑）。

items.en: Currere meant to run, and time was seen as running.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，而时间也被看作在跑。

items.en: Corant described what is running at this hour.
items.cn: corant 形容此刻正在跑的东西。

items.en: Current could already mean happening now.
items.cn: current 已经可以表示「此刻发生的」。

items.en: The adverb -ly form marked the manner of being present.
items.cn: 加 -ly 的副词形式，用来标记「以当下的状态」。

items.en: Currently became the neutral way to date a report.
items.cn: currently 成了给陈述标注时间的常用中性说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names other time words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curr- 词干，近义组列出其他表示时间的词。

entries.definition: happening or flowing now
entries.definitionCN: 现在正在发生或流动的

entries.definition: the money a country uses
a small dried grape
at this very moment
at the present time
in these modern days

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a calendar page and end with a door sign that explains itself.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一页日历开始，落到一块把话说清楚的门牌上。

normal.en: Currently always points at today, never at last year.
normal.cn: currently 总是指向今天，从不指向去年。

normal.en: A closed door with a note is currently closed, not forever closed.
normal.cn: 贴着纸条的关门，是暂时的关，不是永远。

normal.en: News uses currently to say what is true this hour.
normal.cn: 新闻用 currently 来说这一小时为真的事。

normal.en: Currently is current with an -ly tail: happening in this manner.
normal.cn: currently 就是 current 拖一条 -ly 的尾巴：以当下的方式。

normal.en: If the state may change by Friday, say currently.
normal.cn: 如果到了周五情况可能变，那就说 currently。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar page that has not been turned yet.
abstract.cn: 想象一页还没翻过去的日历。

abstract.en: Picture a sign taped to a door, flapping in the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一张贴在门上的纸，在风里轻轻拍打。

abstract.en: Picture a clock whose second hand is caught mid-step.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟，秒针被定格在半路上。

examples.en: He is currently on the phone.
examples.cn: 他此刻正在打电话。

examples.en: The bridge is currently under repair.
examples.cn: 这座桥目前正在维修。

examples.en: Currently, no one lives in that house.
examples.cn: 目前没有人住在那栋房子里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 currently 记成「当前地」：current 是正在跑的，加上 -ly 就变成「以此刻的方式」。

root: 由 current 加副词后缀 -ly 构成；current 源自拉丁语 currere（跑、流动），因此 currently 的本义是「以正在流动的、当下的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: From this exact moment, to this period, to a state that lasts until further notice.
sensesIntro.cn: 从这一刻，到这一时期，再到持续到另有通知为止的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a calendar left open on today's page.
core.cn: 核心意象：日历摊开在今天这一页。

branches.en: The word pins a statement to this exact moment.
branches.cn: 这个词把一句话钉在此刻。

branches.en: It also sets the present period against earlier ones.
branches.cn: 它还把当前时期放在更早的时期旁边。

branches.en: A temporary state still needs a word that dates it.
branches.cn: 暂时的状态，也需要一个标注时间的词。

branches.en: This moment and this period differ only in width.
branches.cn: 这一刻和这一时期，只差在宽窄。

branches.en: Both senses leave room for a later change.
branches.cn: 两种意思都为日后的变化留了余地。

intro.en: Currently is a small adverb built on the curr- family, where running becomes the present hour.
intro.cn: currently 是由 curr- 这一族构成的小副词，「跑」在这里变成眼前的时辰。

latinIntro.en: The Latin currere, to run, supplies the stem; the English -ly supplies the adverb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 currere（跑）提供词干，英语后缀 -ly 把它变成副词。

items.example: She is currently in Beijing.
The current plan is too costly.
The currency fell against the dollar.
items.exampleCN: 这种货币对美元贬值了。

items.example: Two projects ran concurrently.

items.meaning: the course a learner runs through
items.example: The curriculum was revised this year.
items.exampleCN: 课程体系今年做了修订。

items.example: The pain may recur in winter.
items.exampleCN: 这种疼痛冬天可能再犯。

items.meaning: to come to mind or take place
items.example: The idea occurred to her later.
items.exampleCN: 这个想法她后来才想到。

items.meaning: a hidden flow beneath the surface
items.example: An undercurrent of anger ran through the room.
items.exampleCN: 房间里流动着一股暗藏的怒气。

items.meaning: events in the news right now
items.example: He follows current affairs closely.

definition_zh: 课程体系；全部课程；履历
definition_en: the full set of courses taught in a school or a programme of study
core_image: 一张排满格子的课程表，每格写着一门科目
scene: 教务处的墙上贴着一整年的课程安排，格子排得密密麻麻。The school revised its curriculum last year.
sceneCN: 这里 curriculum 指「课程体系」（第 1 个义项：学校开设的全部课程）；句意是学校去年修订了课程体系。

pos.zh: 课程体系；全部课程；履历

senses.title: Course of study
senses.definition: the full set of courses offered by a school
senses.definitionCN: 一所学校开设的全部课程
senses.example: The curriculum includes art and music.
senses.exampleCN: 课程体系里包含美术和音乐。
senses.why: A school is judged by the whole track it lays out.
senses.whyCN: 看一所学校，看的是它铺出来的整条跑道。

senses.title: A planned programme
senses.definition: an ordered plan of what will be taught and in what order
senses.definitionCN: 关于教什么、按什么顺序教的有序安排
senses.example: Teachers helped design the new curriculum.
senses.exampleCN: 教师们参与设计了新的课程方案。
senses.why: Someone must decide the order before the term begins.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人在开学前把顺序定下来。

senses.title: A life record
senses.definition: a short account of one's education and work, in the phrase curriculum vitae
senses.definitionCN: 在 curriculum vitae 这一说法中，指个人教育与工作经历简述
senses.example: Send your curriculum vitae with the letter.
senses.exampleCN: 随信附上你的履历。
senses.why: A life too has a course that can be written down.
senses.whyCN: 人的一生也有跑道，也能被写下来。

intro.en: Curriculum is Latin for a running or a racecourse, from currere, to run; a course of study is a track learners run along.
intro.cn: curriculum 在拉丁语里意为「跑」或「跑道」，出自 currere（跑）；一门课程就是学生要跑的那条道。

items.en: Currere meant to run, and curriculum meant a running.
items.cn: currere 意为跑，curriculum 意为奔跑。

items.en: Curriculum also named the track a chariot ran on.
items.cn: curriculum 也指战车奔跑的跑道。

items.en: Roman writers used it for a fixed course of duties.
items.cn: 罗马作家用它指一套固定的职责流程。

items.en: Universities borrowed it for the course students run through.
items.cn: 大学借用它，指学生要跑完的课程。

items.en: Curriculum came to mean every subject a school teaches.
items.cn: curriculum 后来指一所学校教的全部科目。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curr- stem, and the meaning group names other plans of study.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curr- 词干，近义组列出其他表示学习安排的说法。

entries.definition: the plural of curriculum
relating to a course of study
outside the normal course of study
an outline of what a course will cover
a series of lessons on one subject
entries.definitionCN: 关于一个科目的一系列课

entries.definition: an organised plan of study or events
entries.definitionCN: 有组织的学习或活动安排

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a track marked on the ground and end with a sheet listing a person's whole life.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从地上画出的一条跑道开始，落到一张写满一生的纸。

normal.en: A curriculum is a track, and students are the runners.
normal.cn: 课程体系是一条跑道，学生是跑在上面的人。

normal.en: Every subject is one lane on the same track.
normal.cn: 每门科目都是同一条跑道上的一个分道。

normal.en: Teachers build the track before the runners arrive.
normal.cn: 老师要在学生到来之前把跑道修好。

normal.en: Extracurricular means running beside the track, not on it.
normal.cn: extracurricular 是在跑道旁边跑，而不是在跑道上。

normal.en: A curriculum vitae is the course your life has run.
normal.cn: 履历就是你这一生跑过的那条道。

abstract.en: Picture lanes painted on a school playground.
abstract.cn: 想象学校操场上画出的分道。

abstract.en: Picture a timetable with every square filled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张每个格子都写满的课表。

abstract.en: Picture a single page that sums up many years.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸把许多年压缩在一起。

examples.en: The curriculum includes art and music.
examples.cn: 课程体系里包含美术和音乐。

examples.en: Teachers helped design the new curriculum.
examples.cn: 教师们参与设计了新的课程方案。

examples.en: Two subjects were added to the curriculum.
examples.cn: 有两门科目被加进了课程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curriculum 记成「跑道」：curr 是跑，课程就是学校替你铺好的那条跑道。

root: 源自拉丁语 curriculum（跑道、奔跑），出自 currere（跑）；古罗马用它指战车跑道，后来大学借用来指学生要跑完的整套课程。

sensesIntro.en: From the whole track of courses, to the plan behind it, to the course a whole life has run.
sensesIntro.cn: 从整套课程铺成的跑道，到背后的安排，再到一生跑过的那条道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a track marked out for learners to run along.
core.cn: 核心意象：为学习者划出的一条跑道。

branches.en: The whole track is the sum of every course offered.
branches.cn: 整条跑道，就是所有开设课程的总和。

branches.en: Someone must draw the track before anyone runs.
branches.cn: 在有人跑之前，得先有人把跑道画出来。

branches.en: A life also has a course, written down on one page.
branches.cn: 人生也有跑道，被写在一页纸上。

branches.en: The track and its plan are named by the same word.
branches.cn: 跑道和它的图纸，用的是同一个词。

branches.en: A planned course and a recorded life share the idea of running.
branches.cn: 安排好的课程与记录下的人生，共享「跑」这个意象。

intro.en: Curriculum belongs to the curr- family, where the image of running becomes a course of study.
intro.cn: curriculum 属于 curr- 这一族，「跑」的意象在这里变成一门门课程。

latinIntro.en: The Latin curriculum, a racecourse, comes from currere, to run.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 curriculum（跑道）出自 currere（跑）。

items.meaning: the course a learner runs through
items.example: The curriculum was revised this year.
items.exampleCN: 课程体系今年做了修订。

items.meaning: more than one course of study
items.example: The two curricula overlap.
Curricular changes take years.
She joined an extracurricular club.
items.exampleCN: 她加入了一个课外社团。

items.example: The trip is cocurricular.
items.exampleCN: 这次出游是与课程配合的。

items.meaning: the course of one's life, a CV
items.example: Attach your curriculum vitae.
The current is strong near the rocks.
The pain may recur in winter.
items.exampleCN: 这种疼痛冬天可能再犯。

items.meaning: a path or a series of lessons
items.example: The course lasts ten weeks.

definition_en: to call down harm on someone in words, or a cause of lasting trouble
core_image: 老人对着门槛啐一口，低声吐出一串狠话
scene: 老太太对着门槛啐了一口，低声念出一串难听的话。She cursed the man who had cheated her.
sceneCN: 这里 cursed 是 curse 的过去式，指「咒骂」（第 2 个义项：用难听的话发泄怒气）；句意是她咒骂那个骗过她的人。

senses.title: Words that wish harm
senses.definition: words spoken to bring harm or bad luck upon someone
senses.definitionCN: 为把伤害或厄运带给某人而说出的话
senses.example: The old woman muttered a curse at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 老妇人在门口低声念了一句诅咒。
senses.why: Words are the cheapest weapon, and the hardest to recall.
senses.whyCN: 话是最便宜的武器，也最难收回。

senses.title: To swear at
senses.definition: to say angry, rude words about someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 用愤怒粗鲁的话骂某人或某事
senses.example: He cursed the driver who splashed him.
senses.exampleCN: 他咒骂那个溅了他一身水的司机。
senses.why: Anger looks for a target and finds one in words.
senses.whyCN: 怒气总要找一个目标，于是在话里找到了。

senses.title: A cause of trouble
senses.definition: something that brings great and lasting trouble
senses.definitionCN: 带来巨大而持久麻烦的事物
senses.example: That old car became a curse for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车成了这家的祸根。
senses.why: A thing can weigh on a life the way a spell is said to.
senses.whyCN: 一件东西压在生活上，就像传说里的咒语一样。

intro.en: Curse comes from Old English cursian, to utter words that wish harm; its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: curse 源自古英语 cursian（说出希望别人遭殃的话），更早的来源已不可确考。

items.en: Cursian meant to speak words that wish harm.
items.cn: cursian 意为说出希望别人遭殃的话。

items.en: The noun curs named such a spoken wish.
items.cn: 名词 curs 指这样一句说出口的恶愿。

items.en: Curs spread from church curses to everyday swearing.
items.cn: curs 从教会的诅咒扩展到日常骂人。

items.en: It also named a person or thing that brings ruin.
items.cn: 它也指带来毁灭的人或物。

items.en: Curse keeps both the formal spell and the casual swear.
items.cn: curse 同时保留了正式的咒语和随口的骂话。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening, and the meaning group names other ways of wishing harm.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 开头，近义组列出其他表达恶愿的说法。

a line that bends smoothly
to swear in casual speech
to use rude words in anger
to condemn someone to punishment
a spell meant to bring bad luck

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a word spat at a doorstep and end with a thing nobody can get rid of.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门槛上啐出的一句话开始，落到一件谁也甩不掉的东西上。

normal.en: A curse is anger given grammar and aimed.
normal.cn: 诅咒就是给怒气装上语法，再瞄准。

normal.en: The same word covers a witch's spell and a driver's bad language.
normal.cn: 同一个词既指巫师的咒语，也指司机的脏话。

normal.en: A curse is said to follow a family for generations.
normal.cn: 据说诅咒会跟着一个家族走好几代。

normal.en: When a thing ruins every year, people call it a curse.
normal.cn: 当一样东西年年坏事，人们就叫它祸根。

normal.en: You can lift a curse, but not the words already heard.
normal.cn: 诅咒可以解除，已经听进耳朵的话却收不回。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised at a doorway in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中有人在门口举起一只手。

abstract.en: Picture a mouth shaping words that nobody wants to hear.
abstract.cn: 想象一张嘴正在拼出谁也不愿听的话。

abstract.en: Picture an old car that breaks down every winter.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆每年冬天都要坏一次的旧车。

examples.en: The old woman muttered a curse at the door.
examples.cn: 老妇人在门口低声念了一句诅咒。

examples.en: He cursed the driver who splashed him.
examples.cn: 他咒骂那个溅了他一身水的司机。

examples.en: That old car became a curse for the family.
examples.cn: 那辆旧车成了这家的祸根。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curse 记成「啐」：对着人啐一口，再吐出一串狠话，就是诅咒。

root: 源自古英语 cursian（说出希望别人遭殃的话），名词形式为 curs；本义是用言语祈求他人受害，后来引申为骂人，再引申为带来持久麻烦的祸根。

sensesIntro.en: From words that wish harm, to angry swearing, to a thing that ruins a life.
sensesIntro.cn: 从祈求别人遭殃的话，到愤怒的骂声，再到毁掉生活的祸根。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raised at a doorway while hard words are spoken.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人在门口举起手，嘴里吐出狠话。

branches.en: The oldest picture is a spoken wish for harm.
branches.cn: 最古老的画面，是一句说出口的恶愿。

branches.en: The same act appears when anger simply needs to swear.
branches.cn: 当怒气只是想骂出来时，出现的是同一种动作。

branches.en: A thing that ruins a life is felt to be under a spell.
branches.cn: 毁掉生活的东西，让人觉得像中了咒。

branches.en: A solemn spell and a casual swear are the same words in different clothes.
branches.cn: 庄重的咒语和随口的脏话，是同一批话换了衣服。

branches.en: Swearing at a thing turns it into the enemy in the house.
branches.cn: 骂一样东西，就把它变成了屋里的敌人。

intro.en: Curse is an Old English word with a small family, all of it built on spoken harm.
intro.cn: curse 是古英语词，词族不大，全都围绕「说出口的伤害」建成。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it comes from Old English cursian.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 cursian。

items.example: She cursed him under her breath.
They believed the house was cursed.
items.exampleCN: 他们相信那房子受了诅咒。

items.example: The cursing stopped at midnight.
That accursed noise never stops.
items.exampleCN: 那该诅咒的噪音一刻不停。

items.meaning: a rude word used in anger
items.example: He used a curse word and apologised.
Do not curse at the referee.

items.meaning: to place a spell on someone
items.example: The story says she put a curse on the well.
items.exampleCN: 故事说她给那口井下了咒。

items.example: Only a kind act could lift the curse.
items.exampleCN: 只有善举才能解除诅咒。

definition_en: a piece of cloth hung to cover a window, a stage, or anything that needs hiding
core_image: 米色布帘被拉开，午后的光从缝里涌进来
scene: 她拉开窗帘，让午后的光铺满地板。She drew back the curtain and let the light in.
sceneCN: 这里 curtain 指「窗帘」（第 1 个义项：挂在窗上遮光挡视线的布）；句意是她拉开窗帘让光进来。

pos.zh: 给…装上窗帘；用帘子遮住

senses.title: Window cloth
senses.definition: a cloth hung over a window to block light or keep privacy
senses.definitionCN: 挂在窗上用于遮光或保护隐私的布
senses.example: She closed the curtains before the film.
senses.exampleCN: 电影开始前她拉上了窗帘。
senses.why: A window is a hole in the wall, and cloth decides how much of it stays open.
senses.whyCN: 窗户是墙上的一个洞，布决定这个洞开多大。

senses.title: Stage cloth
senses.definition: the large cloth that hides or reveals a stage
senses.definitionCN: 遮住或揭开舞台的大块布幕
senses.example: The curtain rose on a dark stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幕布在一片漆黑的舞台上拉开。
senses.why: Theatre needs a line between the world and the story.
senses.whyCN: 戏台需要一条线，把现实和故事隔开。

senses.title: A hanging screen
senses.definition: something that screens or hides, like a hanging cloth
senses.definitionCN: 像垂下的布一样遮挡或隐藏事物的东西
senses.example: A curtain of mist covered the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 一层雾幕盖住了山谷。
senses.why: Anything that falls between the eye and the thing can act as cloth.
senses.whyCN: 凡是落在眼睛与事物之间的，都能像布一样起作用。

intro.en: Curtain comes from Latin cortina, a curtain or cauldron, through Old French cortine.
intro.cn: curtain 源自拉丁语 cortina（帘幕、大锅），经古法语 cortine 进入英语。

items.en: Cortina named a curtain that screened a space.
items.cn: cortina 指用来隔开空间的帘幕。

items.en: The same word could also mean a round cauldron.
items.cn: 同一个词也能指一口圆锅。

items.en: Cortine kept the sense of a hanging screen of cloth.
items.cn: cortine 保留了垂挂布幕的意思。

items.en: Curtain first hung in churches and great halls.

items.en: The theatre gave it the sense of a stage curtain.
items.cn: 剧院赋予它舞台幕布的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening, and the meaning group names other things that screen a space.

a small bow made by bending the knees
to turn milk sour and thick
cloth hung in loose folds
a screen pulled down over a window
a flat object that hides or divides
entries.definitionCN: 用来遮挡或隔开的平面物

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with light coming through a gap in cloth and end with mist that behaves like a curtain.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从布缝里透进来的光开始，落到像帘子一样起作用的雾。

normal.en: A curtain decides how much morning you deserve.
normal.cn: 窗帘决定你配得到多少早晨的光。

normal.en: On stage, the curtain is the line between two worlds.
normal.cn: 舞台上，幕布就是两个世界之间的那条线。

normal.en: Curtain call is the moment the cloth lets the actors be seen again.
normal.cn: 谢幕，就是布重新让演员被看见的那一刻。

normal.en: Mist can hang like a curtain with no rail at all.
normal.cn: 雾也能像帘子一样垂着，却不需要任何杆子。

normal.en: If cloth stands between you and the view, it is a curtain.
normal.cn: 如果一块布挡在你和风景之间，它就是帘子。

abstract.en: Picture a pale beam of light cut by a cloth edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一道苍白的光被布边切开。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy red cloth falling slowly on a stage.
abstract.cn: 想象一块厚重的红布在舞台上缓缓落下。

abstract.en: Picture a wall of rain moving across a field.
abstract.cn: 想象一堵雨墙从田野上推过去。

examples.en: She drew back the curtain and let the light in.
examples.cn: 她拉开窗帘，让光进来。

examples.en: The curtain rose on a dark stage.
examples.cn: 幕布在一片漆黑的舞台上拉开。

examples.en: A curtain of mist covered the valley.
examples.cn: 一层雾幕盖住了山谷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curtain 记成「挡」：一块布挡在窗前是窗帘，挡在台前是幕布，挡在山前是雾幕。

root: 源自拉丁语 cortina（帘幕，也指圆锅），经古法语 cortine 进入英语；本义是挂在教堂与大厅里的隔断布，后来指窗帘与舞台幕布，再引申为一切遮挡物。

sensesIntro.en: From cloth across a window, to cloth across a stage, to anything that hangs between eye and world.
sensesIntro.cn: 从挡在窗前的布，到挡在台前的布，再到一切垂在眼睛与世界之间的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide cloth hung across an opening.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块宽大的布横挂在一个开口前。

branches.en: The first use is cloth over a window, ruling the light.
branches.cn: 最早的用法是窗上的布，管着光。

branches.en: The stage borrows the same cloth to hide its world.
branches.cn: 舞台借用同一块布，藏起自己的世界。

branches.en: Mist and rain can hang like cloth and hide a whole valley.
branches.cn: 雾和雨能像布一样垂着，藏起整片山谷。

branches.en: Window and stage both use cloth to time what is seen.
branches.cn: 窗户与舞台都用布来控制「什么时候被看见」。

branches.en: The stage curtain and the mist both mark a boundary.
branches.cn: 舞台幕布与雾幕，都在标记一条边界。

intro.en: Curtain is a Latin borrowing with a small English family, all built on hanging cloth.
intro.cn: curtain 是拉丁语借词，英语词族不大，全都围绕垂挂的布。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cortina, a curtain, is the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cortina（帘幕）是这一族词的来源。

items.example: The curtain moved in the wind.
The curtains were faded by sun.
items.exampleCN: 窗帘被太阳晒得褪了色。

items.example: A curtained window kept the room dark.
items.exampleCN: 挂着窗帘的窗让房间很暗。

items.example: They spent Sunday curtaining the hall.
items.exampleCN: 他们周日都在给大厅挂帘子。

items.meaning: a short play before the main one
items.example: The curtain-raiser lasted twenty minutes.
items.exampleCN: 开场短剧演了二十分钟。

items.meaning: the moment actors return to bow
items.example: The crowd stood for the curtain call.

items.meaning: a cloth that keeps water in
items.example: Mould grew on the shower curtain.
They curtained off a corner of the room.
items.exampleCN: 他们把房间一角用帘子隔开。

definition_en: a line that bends smoothly, or to bend and move along such a line
core_image: 一条山路贴着山腰画出一道长长的弧
scene: 山路在前面拐了一个大弯，消失在树后。The road curves sharply to the left.
sceneCN: 这里 curves 是 curve 的第三人称单数，指「转弯」（第 2 个义项：道路弯折）；句意是这条路向左急转。

senses.title: A smooth bend
senses.definition: a line that bends without any sharp angles
senses.definitionCN: 没有任何尖锐折角的弯线
senses.example: The graph shows a smooth curve.
senses.exampleCN: 图表上是一条平滑的曲线。
senses.why: A line that keeps changing direction gently is still one unbroken line.
senses.whyCN: 一条不断轻轻改变方向的线，仍然是不断的一整条。

senses.title: A bend in a road
senses.definition: a place where a road, river, or path turns
senses.definitionCN: 道路、河流或小径转弯的地方
senses.example: Slow down before the curve.
senses.exampleCN: 过弯道前要减速。
senses.why: What is straight on a map can bend on the ground.
senses.whyCN: 地图上笔直的路，到了地上也可能弯。

senses.title: To bend
senses.definition: to move or make something move in a curved line
senses.definitionCN: 沿曲线移动，或使某物沿曲线移动
senses.example: The path curves around the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 小径绕着湖弯过去。
senses.why: Anything that avoids an obstacle must go round it.
senses.whyCN: 凡是绕开障碍的东西，都得弯过去。

intro.en: Curve comes from Latin curvus, bent or crooked, which passed through the English of the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: curve 源自拉丁语 curvus（弯的、曲的），在十七世纪进入英语。

items.en: Curvus described anything bent out of a straight line.
items.cn: curvus 形容一切偏离直线的弯。

items.en: Curvare meant to bend something into a bow.
items.cn: curvare 意为把东西弯成弓形。

items.en: Curve first named a bent line in geometry.
items.cn: curve 最初指几何中的弯线。

items.en: It spread to roads, rivers, and the human body.
items.cn: 它扩展到道路、河流和人的身体。

items.en: Curve also became a verb meaning to move in a bend.
items.cn: curve 也变成动词，表示沿弯线移动。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening, and the meaning group names other kinds of bending.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 开头，近义组列出其他表示弯折的说法。

to cut shapes into wood or stone
entries.definitionCN: 在木头或石头上刻出形状

entries.definition: to keep something under control
to make a straight thing crooked
a curved line like part of a circle
entries.definitionCN: 像圆的一部分那样的弯线

entries.definition: a change of direction

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a line that leaves the ruler and end with a road that hides itself behind trees.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一条离开直尺的线开始，落到一条藏在树后的路。

normal.en: A curve is a straight line that changed its mind slowly.
normal.cn: 曲线，就是慢慢改变主意的直线。

normal.en: Roads bend because hills will not move.
normal.cn: 路会弯，是因为山不肯让开。

normal.en: A learning curve bends upward because skill grows unevenly.
normal.cn: 学习曲线往上弯，因为本事长得不均匀。

normal.en: To be ahead of the curve is to turn before the road does.
normal.cn: 领先于潮流，就是在路转弯之前先转。

normal.en: If it never holds a straight line, it is a curve.
normal.cn: 如果它从不肯走直线，它就是曲线。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil line leaning away from a ruler.
abstract.cn: 想象一条铅笔线慢慢偏离直尺。

abstract.en: Picture headlights sweeping across a hillside turn.
abstract.cn: 想象车灯扫过山腰的弯道。

abstract.en: Picture a river bending around a field of reeds.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河绕过芦苇地弯过去。

examples.en: The graph shows a smooth curve.
examples.cn: 图表上是一条平滑的曲线。

examples.en: Slow down before the curve.
examples.cn: 过弯道前要减速。

examples.en: The path curves around the lake.
examples.cn: 小径绕着湖弯过去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curve 记成「弯」：路不肯直着走，就画出一道弧，这道弧就是曲线。

root: 源自拉丁语 curvus（弯的），动词为 curvare（使弯成弓形）；本义是偏离直线的弯，先用于几何，后用于道路、河流与身体。

sensesIntro.en: From a bent line on paper, to a bend in the road, to the act of bending around something.
sensesIntro.cn: 从纸上的一条弯线，到路上的一个弯，再到绕过障碍的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line that leaves the straight and bends gently away.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条离开直线、轻轻弯出去的线。

branches.en: The pure shape is a line with no sharp corner.
branches.cn: 最纯粹的形状，是一条没有尖角的线。

branches.en: On the ground the same shape becomes a turn in the road.
branches.cn: 到了地面上，同一个形状变成路上的弯。

branches.en: To curve is to trace that line with your own movement.
branches.cn: 弯曲，就是用自己的运动把那条线走出来。

branches.en: Drawn or driven, the bend keeps the same geometry.
branches.cn: 画出来的弯和开出来的弯，几何形状是一样的。

branches.en: A road curves because travellers must curve with it.
branches.cn: 路会弯，是因为走的人也得跟着弯。

intro.en: Curve belongs to the Latin curvus family, where bending grows into geometry, roads, and the body.
intro.cn: curve 属于拉丁语 curvus 这一族，「弯」在这里长成几何、道路和身体。

latinIntro.en: The Latin curvus, bent, and curvare, to bend, stand under this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 curvus（弯的）与 curvare（使弯）是这一族词的根。

items.example: The road makes a wide curve.
The river has many curves.
The blade has a curved edge.
A curving path led uphill.
items.exampleCN: 一条弯曲的小路通向坡上。

items.example: The curvature of the earth is slight.
The road turned curvy near the coast.
items.exampleCN: 路在海岸附近变得弯弯曲曲。

items.meaning: a ball that bends, or a surprise
items.example: Life threw him a curve ball.
items.exampleCN: 生活给他出了个意外难题。

items.meaning: the rate at which skill grows
items.example: The job has a steep learning curve.
items.exampleCN: 这份工作的学习曲线很陡。

items.example: The train took the undercurve slowly.
items.exampleCN: 火车慢慢驶过下方的弯道。

definition_zh: 靠垫；坐垫；缓冲物；缓冲，减轻
definition_en: a soft bag of cloth filled with padding, or something that softens a shock
core_image: 一个鼓鼓的软垫被塞在背后，整个人陷进去
scene: 她把一个软垫塞在背后，靠着墙坐下。She put a cushion behind her back.
sceneCN: 这里 cushion 指「靠垫」（第 1 个义项：填充柔软、用来坐靠的垫子）；句意是她把靠垫垫在背后。

senses.title: A soft pad
senses.definition: a cloth bag filled with soft material, used to sit or lean on
senses.definitionCN: 装满柔软材料、用来坐或靠的布袋
senses.example: She put a cushion behind her back.
senses.exampleCN: 她把靠垫垫在背后。
senses.why: The body needs something between it and the hard frame.
senses.whyCN: 身体和硬框架之间，总得垫点东西。

senses.title: A buffer
senses.definition: something that absorbs a shock or protects against loss
senses.definitionCN: 吸收冲击或防止损失的东西
senses.example: Savings act as a cushion against hard times.
senses.exampleCN: 存款能在艰难时期起缓冲作用。
senses.why: A layer between you and the blow takes part of the blow.
senses.whyCN: 挡在你和打击之间的一层，会替你先挨一下。

senses.title: To soften a blow
senses.definition: to make a fall, shock, or loss less severe
senses.definitionCN: 使跌落、冲击或损失变得不那么严重
senses.example: The grass cushioned his fall.
senses.exampleCN: 草地缓冲了他摔下来的力道。
senses.why: Soft ground gives way, and giving way is what saves a body.
senses.whyCN: 软的地面会让开，而让开正是救人的地方。

intro.en: Cushion comes from Latin culcita, a mattress, through Old French coissin.
intro.cn: cushion 源自拉丁语 culcita（床垫），经古法语 coissin 进入英语。

items.en: Culcita named a stuffed mattress or sack.
items.cn: culcita 指填满东西的床垫或袋垫。

items.en: It also described a pillow for the head.
items.cn: 它也能指头下的枕头。

items.en: Coissin named a soft pad for sitting.
items.cn: coissin 指用来坐的软垫。

items.en: Cushion entered English for the pad of a seat.
items.cn: cushion 进入英语，指座位上的垫子。

items.en: The word grew a verb sense: to soften an impact.
items.cn: 这个词又长出动词义：缓冲冲击。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cush- opening, and the meaning group names other soft things that take a blow.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cush- 开头，近义组列出其他柔软、能替人挨一下的东西。

entries.definition: easy and comfortable, of a job
soft like a cushion
material that absorbs shocks
a soft support for the head
a thick soft piece used for protection
something that reduces a shock

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a soft square under a tired body and end with ground that gives way.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从疲惫身体下的一个软方块开始，落到一片会让开的地面。

normal.en: A cushion is a small promise that the seat will not hurt.
normal.cn: 靠垫是一个小小的承诺：这张椅子不会硌人。

normal.en: Put a layer between you and the blow and the blow arrives smaller.
normal.cn: 在你和打击之间垫一层，打击到了就变小了。

normal.en: Savings are a cushion made of money instead of cloth.
normal.cn: 存款是用钱而不是用布做的靠垫。

normal.en: Grass cushioned the fall because it let the body sink.
normal.cn: 草地能缓冲，是因为它让身体陷进去。

normal.en: Anything that softens a shock is doing a cushion's job.
normal.cn: 凡是让冲击变软的，都在干靠垫的活。

abstract.en: Picture a deep soft square on a wooden bench.
abstract.cn: 想象木长椅上放着一个厚软的方垫。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing into a cushion and leaving a shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按进软垫，留下一个凹痕。

abstract.en: Picture a jumper landing on a mat instead of concrete.
abstract.cn: 想象跳下来的人落在垫子上，而不是水泥地上。

examples.en: She put a cushion behind her back.
examples.cn: 她把靠垫垫在背后。

examples.en: Savings act as a cushion against hard times.
examples.cn: 存款能在艰难时期起缓冲作用。

examples.en: The grass cushioned his fall.
examples.cn: 草地缓冲了他摔下来的力道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cushion 记成「垫」：软的东西垫在身下，也垫在人和打击之间。

root: 源自拉丁语 culcita（床垫、垫袋），经古法语 coissin 进入英语；本义是填满柔软材料的坐垫，后来引申为一切起缓冲作用的东西与动作。

sensesIntro.en: From a pad under the body, to a layer against loss, to the act of taking the edge off a fall.
sensesIntro.cn: 从身下的软垫，到抵御损失的一层，再到把跌落的力道削掉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick soft square placed between a body and a hard surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块厚软的方垫，垫在身体和硬面之间。

branches.en: The first job is to make a hard seat bearable.
branches.cn: 它最开始的本事，是让硬座位能坐。

branches.en: Any layer that stands between you and loss becomes a cushion.
branches.cn: 任何挡在你和损失之间的一层，都成了缓冲物。

branches.en: The verb describes what the pad does to the blow.
branches.cn: 动词说的是垫子对打击做了什么。

branches.en: Cloth and savings do the same work at different scales.
branches.cn: 布垫和存款，在同一件事上做着不同尺度的工作。

branches.en: To cushion is to be the thing that absorbs the shock.
branches.cn: 缓冲，就是去做那个吸收冲击的东西。

intro.en: Cushion comes from a Latin mattress and has grown a small family of soft, easing words.
intro.cn: cushion 出自拉丁语的床垫，长出一小族表示柔软与缓和的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin culcita, a mattress, is the root behind cushion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 culcita（床垫）是 cushion 背后的根。

items.example: The cushion is old and flat.
The sofa came with two cushions.
The chair has a cushioned seat.

items.meaning: material or effect that softens shocks
items.example: The shoes need more cushioning.
items.exampleCN: 这双鞋需要更好的缓冲。

items.example: The moss was thick and cushiony.
He found a cushy job.
items.exampleCN: 他找到一份轻松的差事。

items.example: The seat cushion was torn.
The parcel was packed with an air cushion.

items.meaning: to make a shock easier to bear
items.example: The news was bad, but he cushioned the blow.
items.exampleCN: 消息很糟，但他把冲击缓和了一些。

definition_en: a traditional way of behaving in a group, or a personal habit
core_image: 婚礼上，人们按老规矩互相交换小礼物
scene: 村里人在婚礼上仍按老规矩互换礼物。The custom is still kept in the village.

senses.title: A shared tradition
senses.definition: a traditional way that a group does something
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体做某事的传统方式
senses.example: It is the custom to give gifts at weddings.
senses.exampleCN: 婚礼上送礼物是一种习俗。
senses.why: A group repeats what it once agreed was right.
senses.whyCN: 一群人反复做一件他们曾认定正确的事。

senses.title: A personal habit
senses.definition: something a person regularly does
senses.definitionCN: 一个人经常做某件事
senses.example: It was his custom to walk after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭后散步是他的习惯。
senses.why: One person can be a small group of one, repeating itself.
senses.whyCN: 一个人也可以是一个只有自己的小群体，反复照做。

senses.title: The border office
senses.definition: the office that checks goods and people entering a country, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 检查入境货物与人员的机构，通常用复数
senses.example: We waited an hour at customs.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在海关等了一个小时。
senses.why: The old duty on goods survives in the plural name of the office.
senses.whyCN: 旧时对货物征的税，留在了这个机构名称的复数里。

intro.en: Custom comes from Latin consuetudo, a habit, through Old French costume.
intro.cn: custom 源自拉丁语 consuetudo（习惯），经古法语 costume 进入英语。

items.en: Consuetudo meant a habit or a usual practice.
items.cn: consuetudo 意为习惯或惯常做法。

items.en: It grew from consuescere, to become used to something.
items.cn: 它出自 consuescere（逐渐习惯某事）。

items.en: Costume named the usual way of a group.
items.cn: costume 指一个群体惯常的做法。

items.en: Custom entered English for inherited practice.
items.cn: custom 进入英语，指世代沿袭的做法。

items.en: The plural customs named the tax paid on goods.
items.cn: 复数 customs 指对货物征收的税。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cust- opening, and the meaning group names other repeated behaviours.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cust- 开头，近义组列出其他反复出现的行为方式。

entries.definition: the office that checks imported goods

a belief or practice passed down

entries.definition: something done often without thinking
entries.definitionCN: 常在不假思索时做的事

entries.definition: an accepted way of behaving

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with gifts exchanged at a wedding and end with a border where bags are opened.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从婚礼上互换的礼物开始，落到一个要打开行李的边境。

normal.en: A custom is a habit that a whole village shares.
normal.cn: 习俗，是整个村子共有的习惯。

normal.en: One person repeating a walk after dinner is also a custom.
normal.cn: 一个人每天晚饭后散步，也叫习惯。

normal.en: Customs officers inherit an old word for a tax on goods.
normal.cn: 海关官员继承了一个古老的说法，原本指货物税。

normal.en: Custom-made means the suit follows your measure, not the crowd's.
normal.cn: 定做，就是西装照你的尺寸，而不是照大家的。

normal.en: If everyone does it without asking why, it is a custom.
normal.cn: 如果人人照做却不问为什么，那就是习俗。

abstract.en: Picture two families bowing at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 想象两家人同时鞠躬。

abstract.en: Picture the same path worn into a lawn by one pair of shoes.
abstract.cn: 想象一双鞋在草地上踩出同一条小路。

abstract.en: Picture a long queue of bags waiting to be opened.
abstract.cn: 想象一长排行李等着被打开。

examples.en: It is the custom to give gifts at weddings.
examples.cn: 婚礼上送礼物是一种习俗。

examples.en: It was his custom to walk after dinner.
examples.cn: 晚饭后散步是他的习惯。

examples.en: We waited an hour at customs.
examples.cn: 我们在海关等了一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 custom 记成「照旧」：一群人照旧做同一件事，就是习俗；一个人照旧做，就是习惯。

root: 源自拉丁语 consuetudo（习惯），出自 consuescere（逐渐习惯），经古法语 costume 进入英语；本义是群体沿袭的做法，复数为 customs 时指对进口货物征收的税，即后来的海关。

sensesIntro.en: From what a whole group repeats, to what one person repeats, to the office that grew out of an old tax.
sensesIntro.cn: 从整个群体反复做的事，到一个人反复做的事，再到由旧税长出来的机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same act performed again by many hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个动作被许多双手一遍遍重复。

branches.en: A group turns repetition into tradition.
branches.cn: 一个群体把重复变成传统。

branches.en: A single person can hold a tradition of one.
branches.cn: 一个人也能守住只有自己的传统。

branches.en: The plural kept the old tax and became the border office.
branches.cn: 复数形式留下了旧税，后来变成边境机构。

branches.en: Shared and personal habits differ only in how many people keep them.
branches.cn: 共同习惯与个人习惯，只差在有多少人守着它。

branches.en: Both the walk after dinner and the customs queue are things done by rule.
branches.cn: 晚饭后的散步和海关的排队，都是按规矩做的事。

intro.en: Custom belongs to the Latin consuetudo family, where being used to something becomes tradition and trade.
intro.cn: custom 属于拉丁语 consuetudo 这一族，「习惯」在这里变成传统与贸易。

latinIntro.en: The Latin consuetudo, a habit, and consuescere, to grow used to, are the roots.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 consuetudo（习惯）与 consuescere（逐渐习惯）是这些词的根。

items.example: The custom dates back centuries.
items.exampleCN: 这个习俗可追溯到几个世纪前。

items.meaning: the border office or its duty
items.example: The goods were held at customs.

items.meaning: one who regularly uses a shop
items.example: The customer paid in cash.
It is customary to bow here.
You can customize the phone case.
They ordered a custom-built desk.
items.exampleCN: 他们订了一张定制的书桌。

items.example: He wears custom-made shoes.
The customs duty was raised.

definition_en: a person who buys goods or services from a shop or a business
core_image: 店员隔着柜台把包好的东西递给客人
scene: 柜台后的店员笑着迎接推门进来的客人。The customer asked for a refund.
sceneCN: 这里 customer 指「顾客」（第 1 个义项：到店里买东西的人）；句意是这位顾客要求退款。

senses.title: A buyer in a shop
senses.definition: a person who buys goods from a shop
senses.definitionCN: 到商店购买商品的人
senses.example: The customer asked for a refund.
senses.exampleCN: 这位顾客要求退款。
senses.why: A shop exists only while someone walks in and pays.
senses.whyCN: 商店只在有人走进来付钱时才存在。

senses.title: A client of a business
senses.definition: a person or firm that pays a company for its services
senses.definitionCN: 为公司服务付费的个人或企业
senses.example: The bank lost a big customer.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行失去了一个大客户。
senses.why: Services need someone who keeps coming back.
senses.whyCN: 服务需要有人愿意一再回来。

senses.title: A person to deal with
senses.definition: a person of a certain kind, in informal speech
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指某一类人
senses.example: He is a tough customer to please.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个很难讨好的家伙。
senses.why: Even a difficult person is someone you must serve.
senses.whyCN: 再难缠的人，也是你得应付的客人。

intro.en: Customer is custom plus -er: one who customarily comes to a shop.
intro.cn: customer 由 custom 加 -er 构成：习惯性上门的人。

items.en: Consuetudo meant a habit or usual practice.
items.cn: consuetudo 意为习惯或惯常做法。

items.en: Costume named the usual way of a place.
items.cn: costume 指一个地方惯常的做法。

items.en: Custom came to mean regular trade at a shop.
items.cn: custom 后来指商店里固定的生意往来。

items.en: Customer named the one who brought that trade.
items.cn: customer 指带来这门生意的那个人。

items.en: The word widened to any buyer of goods or services.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到任何购买商品或服务的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cust- opening, and the meaning group names other people who buy.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cust- 开头，近义组列出其他买东西的人。

entries.definition: a traditional way of behaving
the office that checks imported goods
clothes worn for a play
a person looking round the shops
a person who pays for professional services
a person who buys something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a bell over a shop door and end with a difficult man at the counter.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从店门上的一只铃开始，落到柜台前一个难缠的人。

normal.en: A customer is someone who has made coming here a custom.
normal.cn: 顾客，就是把来这家店变成了习惯的人。

normal.en: The shop door only rings when trust walks in.
normal.cn: 店门上的铃，只在信任走进来时响。

normal.en: Customer service is the art of keeping a habit alive.
normal.cn: 客户服务，是让一个习惯活下去的手艺。

normal.en: A regular customer needs no map to find the door.
normal.cn: 老顾客不用地图也能找到门。

normal.en: A tough customer is still a customer, and still right.
normal.cn: 难缠的顾客仍是顾客，也仍然「是对的」。

abstract.en: Picture a hand passing a paper bag across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把纸袋递过柜台。

abstract.en: Picture a bell ringing as the door swings open.
abstract.cn: 想象门被推开时铃铛响起。

abstract.en: Picture a queue forming before the shutters rise.
abstract.cn: 想象卷帘门升起前就排起的一队人。

examples.en: The customer asked for a refund.
examples.cn: 这位顾客要求退款。

examples.en: The bank lost a big customer.
examples.cn: 这家银行失去了一个大客户。

examples.en: Good customer service keeps people coming back.
examples.cn: 好的客户服务让人愿意再来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 customer 记成「习惯来的人」：custom 是习惯，-er 是人，习惯来店里的人就是顾客。

root: 由 custom（习惯）加后缀 -er 构成；custom 源自拉丁语 consuetudo（习惯），本义是「习惯性上门的人」，后来泛指一切购买商品或服务的客户。

sensesIntro.en: From a person who buys in a shop, to a firm that buys a service, to a difficult person one must handle.
sensesIntro.cn: 从在店里买东西的人，到购买服务的企业，再到必须应付的难缠人物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand passing goods across a counter.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把商品递过柜台。

branches.en: The first picture is a buyer at a shop counter.
branches.cn: 第一幅画面，是商店柜台前的买主。

branches.en: A firm can be a customer too, buying service by contract.
branches.cn: 企业也能是客户，按合同购买服务。

branches.en: Anyone you must serve can be called a customer in speech.
branches.cn: 口语里，你必须应付的人都可叫 customer。

branches.en: Shopping and contracts both rest on repeat business.
branches.cn: 逛店与签约，都靠回头生意撑着。

branches.en: A client and a difficult fellow are both people to handle.
branches.cn: 客户和难缠的家伙，都是要应付的人。

intro.en: Customer is a plain English build on custom, and its family spreads into trade and habit.
intro.cn: customer 是在 custom 上用英语构词法搭出来的，词族延伸到贸易与习惯。

latinIntro.en: The Latin consuetudo, a habit, lies under custom and customer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 consuetudo（习惯）是 custom 与 customer 共同的根。

items.example: The customer paid in cash.
The sale brought in new customers.
items.exampleCN: 这次促销带来了新顾客。

items.example: The custom dates back centuries.
items.exampleCN: 这个习俗可追溯到几个世纪前。

items.example: It is customary to bow here.
You can customize the case.
The goods were held at customs.
Customer service answered at once.
items.exampleCN: 客户服务马上接了电话。

items.meaning: all the buyers a firm has
items.example: The customer base is young.

definition_en: to divide or open something with a sharp edge, or a reduction or opening made that way
core_image: 厨师一刀把长面包切成两半
scene: 厨师把长面包切成厚薄一致的片。He cut the bread into even slices.
sceneCN: 这里 cut 指「切」（第 1 个义项：用刀把东西分开）；句意是他把面包切成均匀的片。

senses.title: Divide with a blade
senses.definition: to divide or open something with a sharp edge
senses.definitionCN: 用锋利的刃把东西分开或划开
senses.example: He cut the bread into even slices.
senses.exampleCN: 他把面包切成均匀的片。
senses.why: A sharp edge does in one stroke what hands cannot do at all.
senses.whyCN: 一条锋刃一下就做到手完全做不到的事。

senses.title: Reduce the amount
senses.definition: to make a sum, price, or supply smaller
senses.definitionCN: 使金额、价格或供给变少
senses.example: The company cut prices by ten percent.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把价格降了一成。
senses.why: A budget is cut the way a cake is cut: a piece is taken away.
senses.whyCN: 削减预算就像切蛋糕：拿走一块。

senses.title: An opening in skin
senses.definition: a narrow opening made in skin or a surface by something sharp
senses.definitionCN: 锐器在皮肤或表面留下的细长开口
senses.example: The cut on his hand needed two stitches.
senses.exampleCN: 他手上的伤口需要缝两针。
senses.why: The blade leaves its own shape behind on the body.
senses.whyCN: 刀会在身体上留下它自己的形状。

intro.en: Cut appears in Middle English as cutten, probably from a Scandinavian verb; its earlier history is uncertain.
intro.cn: cut 在中古英语中作 cutten，可能来自斯堪的纳维亚语动词，更早的历史已难确考。

items.en: A lost Norse verb likely meant to cut or carve.
items.cn: 一个已失传的古诺斯语动词，可能意为切或刻。

items.en: Cutten appears in English texts for cutting with a blade.
items.cn: cutten 出现在英语文献里，指用刃切开。

items.en: The verb cut took the same form in the past tense.
items.cn: 动词 cut 的过去式也采用同一形式。

items.en: The noun named a wound or a slice.
items.cn: 名词指伤口或切下的一片。

items.en: Cut spread to prices, staff, and lines of text.
items.cn: cut 扩展到价格、人员和文字段落。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cu- shape, and the meaning group names other ways of dividing.
note.cn: 形近组共享短小的 cu- 外形，近义组列出其他分开东西的方式。

entries.definition: pleasant and attractive
brief in a rude way
a small bed for a baby
to cut into thin flat pieces
to cut with heavy blows
to cut away small unwanted parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a knife on a loaf and end with a budget that lost a piece.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从切面包的刀开始，落到少了一块的预算。

normal.en: One word cuts bread, prices, and skin.
normal.cn: 同一个词能切面包、砍价格、割皮肤。

normal.en: A cut always leaves two pieces where there was one.
normal.cn: 一刀下去，总是一块变两块。

normal.en: Cutting costs is cutting a cake, one slice at a time.
normal.cn: 削减成本就是切蛋糕，一次切一片。

normal.en: A cut on the hand is the blade's signature.
normal.cn: 手上的伤口，是刀刃留下的签名。

normal.en: If something sharp divides it, the verb is cut.
normal.cn: 凡是被锋利的东西分开，动词就是 cut。

abstract.en: Picture a knife resting on a warm loaf.
abstract.cn: 想象一把刀停在一只温热的面包上。

abstract.en: Picture a thin red line across a finger.
abstract.cn: 想象手指上一条细细的红线。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet of numbers with one line crossed out.
abstract.cn: 想象一张数字表上被划掉的一行。

examples.en: He cut the bread into even slices.
examples.cn: 他把面包切成均匀的片。

examples.en: The company cut prices by ten percent.
examples.cn: 公司把价格降了一成。

examples.en: The cut on his hand needed two stitches.
examples.cn: 他手上的伤口需要缝两针。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cut 记成「一刀」：一刀切开面包，一刀砍掉预算，一刀留下伤口，都是它。

root: 中古英语作 cutten，可能借自斯堪的纳维亚语的一个动词；本义是用刃分开，后来引申为削减数量、切断关系，以及刀留下的伤口。

sensesIntro.en: From a blade dividing a loaf, to a budget losing a piece, to the line left on skin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从刀刃分开面包，到预算少了一块，再到皮肤上留下的那道线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single stroke of a blade through something whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：一刀划过一件完整的东西。

branches.en: The basic act is a sharp edge meeting a surface.
branches.cn: 最基本的动作，是锋刃碰到表面。

branches.en: A budget is treated like a loaf, with a part removed.
branches.cn: 预算被当成面包，被拿走一部分。

branches.en: The mark left behind is also called a cut.
branches.cn: 留下的那道痕，也叫 cut。

branches.en: Bread and prices both lose a piece to the same verb.
branches.cn: 面包和价格，都被同一个动词拿走一块。

branches.en: What is removed and what is wounded share one word.
branches.cn: 被拿走的部分和受伤的地方，共用一个词。

intro.en: Cut is a short Old English-looking verb with a wide family of tools, marks, and reductions.
intro.cn: cut 是个短小的动词，词族却很宽，涵盖工具、痕迹与削减。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it comes from a Scandinavian verb into Middle English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，它从斯堪的纳维亚语动词进入中古英语。

items.example: Cut the rope here.

items.meaning: the third person or the plural
items.example: She cuts hair for a living.

items.meaning: the act of cutting, or a sharp remark
items.example: The cutting of the cake came last.

items.meaning: a tool or person that cuts
items.example: The wire cutter is in the drawer.

items.meaning: a reduction in spending or staff
items.example: The cutback hit the night shift.
items.exampleCN: 这次裁减影响到了夜班。

items.meaning: the act or style of cutting hair
items.example: He needs a haircut.
They cut down the old tree.
The line was cut off.
We took a shortcut through the field.
items.exampleCN: 我们穿过田野走了条捷径。

definition_zh: 可爱的；小巧漂亮的；精明的
definition_en: attractive in a small or charming way, or clever in a sharp way
core_image: 小狗歪着头看人，尾巴摇得飞快
scene: 小狗歪着头看人，尾巴摇个不停。The cute puppy followed her everywhere.
sceneCN: 这里 cute 指「可爱的」（第 1 个义项：小巧而讨人喜欢）；句意是这只可爱的小狗到处跟着她。

pos.zh: 可爱的；小巧漂亮的；精明的

senses.title: Charming to look at
senses.definition: pleasing and attractive, especially in a small or young way
senses.definitionCN: 讨人喜欢，尤其是小巧或年幼的那种
senses.example: The cute puppy followed her everywhere.
senses.exampleCN: 这只可爱的小狗到处跟着她。
senses.why: Small things that cannot hurt us invite affection at once.
senses.whyCN: 伤不到我们的小东西，会立刻招来喜爱。

senses.title: Neat and pretty
senses.definition: small, neat, and pleasant in design
senses.definitionCN: 设计上小巧、整齐、悦目
senses.example: She wore a cute little hat.
senses.exampleCN: 她戴了一顶小巧漂亮的帽子。
senses.why: A good design can be charming without being grand.
senses.whyCN: 好的设计不必宏大，也能讨人喜欢。

senses.title: Sharp and clever
senses.definition: clever in a way that may be too smart, in informal use
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指聪明得有些过头
senses.example: That was a cute move in the game.
senses.exampleCN: 那一步棋走得挺精明。
senses.why: The old sense of sharpness still hides inside the word.
senses.whyCN: 「锋利」那层旧意思，还藏在这个词里面。

intro.en: Cute began as a shortened form of acute, sharp, in American speech, and later turned toward charm.
intro.cn: cute 最初是 acute（敏锐的、尖的）在美国口语里的缩写，后来转向「讨人喜欢」。

items.en: Acutus meant sharpened or pointed.
items.cn: acutus 意为磨尖的、有尖的。

items.en: Acute described sharp pain and sharp minds.
items.cn: acute 形容尖锐的疼痛与敏锐的头脑。

items.en: American speech clipped acute into cute for clever.
items.cn: 美国口语把 acute 缩成 cute，表示机灵。

items.en: Cute shifted from clever to pretty and charming.
items.cn: cute 从「机灵」转向「漂亮、可爱」。

items.en: It now covers babies, puppies, and small designs.
items.cn: 如今它用于婴儿、小狗和小巧的设计。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cu- shape, and the meaning group names other pleasing qualities.
note.cn: 形近组共享短小的 cu- 外形，近义组列出其他讨人喜欢的特质。

entries.definition: to divide with a blade
to make an illness go away
a solid shape with six square faces
so charming that one loves it
pleasing to look at
pleasing in a warm, winning way
entries.definitionCN: 以温暖讨喜的方式令人愉快的

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a puppy tilting its head and end with a clever move on a board.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从小狗歪头开始，落到棋盘上一步精明的手法。

normal.en: Cute was once acute: sharp first, charming later.
normal.cn: cute 原本是 acute：先锋利，后来才可爱。

normal.en: A tilted head makes a dog look harmless and dear.
normal.cn: 歪一下头，就让狗看起来又无害又招人疼。

normal.en: Small and neat beats large and grand in the word cute.
normal.cn: 在 cute 这个词里，小巧整齐胜过宏大。

normal.en: A cute trick is cleverness showing off its dimples.
normal.cn: cute 的把戏，是机灵露出酒窝的样子。

normal.en: If it makes you smile before you think, it is cute.
normal.cn: 如果它在你思考之前就让你笑了，那就是可爱。

abstract.en: Picture a puppy with one ear folded over.
abstract.cn: 想象一只小狗一只耳朵折下来。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny hat sitting at a perfect angle.
abstract.cn: 想象一顶小帽子以恰到好处的角度戴着。

abstract.en: Picture a chess piece moved two steps ahead of you.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚棋子走在你前面两步。

examples.en: The cute puppy followed her everywhere.
examples.cn: 这只可爱的小狗到处跟着她。

examples.en: She wore a cute little hat.
examples.cn: 她戴了一顶小巧漂亮的帽子。

examples.en: That was a cute move in the game.
examples.cn: 那一步棋走得挺精明。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cute 记成「小尖」：从 acute 剪下来的词，本来指尖，如今指小巧得让人心软。

root: 是 acute（敏锐的、尖的）在美国口语中的缩写形式；acute 源自拉丁语 acutus（磨尖的），本义是「尖」，先指机灵，十九世纪后转指小巧可爱。

sensesIntro.en: From a sharp mind, to a charming face, to a small neat design.
sensesIntro.cn: 从机敏的头脑，到讨喜的脸，再到小巧整齐的设计。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something small that makes you smile at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件小巧、立刻让你笑出来的东西。

branches.en: The everyday sense is a young creature that charms.
branches.cn: 最日常的意思，是惹人喜爱的小生命。

branches.en: A small, well-made object also earns the word.
branches.cn: 小巧精致的物件也能得到这个词。

branches.en: The old sharpness survives when cute means slyly clever.
branches.cn: 当 cute 指「精明」时，旧的锋利意思还在。

branches.en: A puppy and a little hat both please by being small.
branches.cn: 小狗和小帽子，都靠「小」来讨人喜欢。

branches.en: A neat design and a neat trick both show a quick hand.
branches.cn: 精致的设计和漂亮的把戏，都显出快手。

intro.en: Cute is a clipped word, and its small family is built on charm and on the older sense of sharpness.
intro.cn: cute 是个截短词，小词族围绕「讨喜」和更早的「锋利」建成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin acutus, sharpened, is the distant root behind cute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 acutus（磨尖的）是 cute 遥远的根。

items.example: The baby is very cute.
The smaller one is cuter.
That is the cutest picture.
items.exampleCN: 那是最可爱的一张照片。

items.example: She smiled cutely.
The cuteness of the puppy won them over.
items.exampleCN: 小狗的可爱征服了他们。

items.example: Their daughter is a little cutie.
items.exampleCN: 他们的女儿是个小可爱。

items.example: He felt an acute pain.
The acuteness of her hearing surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 她听觉的敏锐让我们吃惊。

items.example: A cute-looking toy sat on the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 架子上放着一个看着很可爱的玩具。

definition_zh: 循环；周期；自行车；骑自行车
definition_en: a series of events that repeats in the same order, a bicycle, or to ride one
core_image: 水从海面升起，成云，落回地面，再流回海里
scene: 水从海面升起，变成云，又落回地面。The water cycle never stops.
sceneCN: 这里 cycle 指「循环」（第 1 个义项：周而复始的过程）；句意是水的循环从不停止。

senses.title: A repeating round
senses.definition: a series of events that returns to its starting point
senses.definitionCN: 一系列事件回到起点、重新开始
senses.example: The water cycle never stops.
senses.exampleCN: 水的循环从不停止。
senses.why: A path that comes back to where it began can be walked again.
senses.whyCN: 一条回到起点的路，可以再走一遍。

senses.title: A bicycle
senses.definition: a vehicle with two wheels turned by pedals
senses.definitionCN: 靠踏板带动两个轮子的交通工具
senses.example: He bought a new cycle for the summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他为夏天买了一辆新自行车。
senses.why: Two wheels going round gave the machine the name of a round.
senses.whyCN: 两个轮子转圈，让这台机器得到了「循环」这个名字。

senses.title: To ride a bicycle
senses.definition: to travel by bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 骑自行车出行
senses.example: She cycles to work every day.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天骑车上班。
senses.why: The rider turns the pedals, and the pedals turn the road into a loop.
senses.whyCN: 骑车人蹬着踏板，踏板把路变成一圈又一圈。

intro.en: Cycle comes from Greek kyklos, a circle or wheel, through Late Latin cyclus.
intro.cn: cycle 源自希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮子），经晚期拉丁语 cyclus 进入英语。

items.en: Kyklos named a circle, a wheel, or a ring.
items.cn: kyklos 指圆圈、轮子或环。

items.en: It could also mean a cycle of years or events.
items.cn: 它也能指年份或事件的一个周期。

items.en: Cyclus kept the sense of a recurring round.
items.cn: cyclus 保留了「反复回到原处」的意思。

items.en: Cycle first named a fixed period of years.
items.cn: cycle 最初指固定的年数周期。

items.en: The bicycle gave cycle its everyday sense of a bike.
items.cn: 自行车让 cycle 有了日常的「单车」义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cycl- stem, and the meaning group names other round movements.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cycl- 词干，近义组列出其他循环往复的运动。

entries.definition: a perfectly round shape
a violent storm that spins
a person who rides a bicycle
one stage in a repeated series
entries.definitionCN: 反复系列中的一个阶段

entries.definition: a path that returns to itself
turning round a centre

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with water rising from the sea and end with two wheels turning under a rider.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从海水升起开始，落到骑手身下转动的两个轮子。

normal.en: A cycle always ends where it began, and starts again.
normal.cn: 循环总在开始的地方结束，然后再开始。

normal.en: The water cycle is a round trip with no ticket.
normal.cn: 水循环是一场不用买票的往返旅行。

normal.en: A vicious cycle is a loop that feeds itself.
normal.cn: 恶性循环，就是自己喂自己的圈。

normal.en: Two wheels going round gave the bicycle its name.
normal.cn: 两个转动的轮子，把名字给了自行车。

normal.en: If it comes back to the start, it is a cycle.
normal.cn: 如果它又回到起点，那就是循环。

abstract.en: Picture rain falling on the sea it came from.
abstract.cn: 想象雨落回它出发的那片海。

abstract.en: Picture a wheel with a small stone stuck in its tread.
abstract.cn: 想象轮子的纹路里卡着一颗小石子。

abstract.en: Picture a rider turning pedals under street lamps.
abstract.cn: 想象骑手在路灯下转着踏板。

examples.en: The water cycle never stops.
examples.cn: 水的循环从不停止。

examples.en: He bought a new cycle for the summer.
examples.cn: 他为夏天买了一辆新自行车。

examples.en: She cycles to work every day.
examples.cn: 她每天骑车上班。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cycle 记成「圈」：事情绕一圈回到原处是循环，车轮绕一圈是自行车。

root: 源自希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮子），经晚期拉丁语 cyclus 进入英语；本义是绕行一圈，先指年岁的周期，后指一切周而复始的过程，也指自行车。

sensesIntro.en: From a round of years, to a round of water, to a bike that turns its wheels.
sensesIntro.cn: 从年岁的轮回，到水的轮回，再到转动轮子的自行车。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a path that curves all the way back to its start.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条绕回起点的小路。

branches.en: The main sense is a process that returns to its start.
branches.cn: 主要意思，是回到起点的过程。

branches.en: Two turning wheels made the bicycle a cycle.
branches.cn: 两个转动的轮子，让自行车也叫 cycle。

branches.en: The verb turns the rider into part of the round.
branches.cn: 动词让骑车人也成了这个圈的一部分。

branches.en: A wheel and a season both come back to the same place.
branches.cn: 轮子和季节，都会回到同一个位置。

branches.en: The machine and the act share one short word.
branches.cn: 机器和动作，共用一个短词。

intro.en: Cycle sits in the Greek kyklos family, where a circle becomes seasons, bikes, and recycling.
intro.cn: cycle 属于希腊语 kyklos 这一族，圆圈在这里变成季节、单车和回收。

latinIntro.en: The Greek kyklos, a circle, reached English through Latin cyclus.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kyklos（圆圈）经拉丁语 cyclus 进入英语。

items.example: The cycle repeats every spring.
items.exampleCN: 这个循环每年春天重来。

items.example: The machine runs in short cycles.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器以短周期运行。

items.example: They cycled along the river.

items.meaning: the activity of riding a bike
items.example: Cycling is good for the knees.
The pattern is cyclic.
The industry has cyclical ups and downs.
items.exampleCN: 这个行业有周期性的起落。

items.example: A cyclist passed us on the left.
items.exampleCN: 一个骑车人从左边超过我们。

items.example: We recycle glass and paper.

items.meaning: the stages of a living thing
items.example: The insect has a short life cycle.
items.exampleCN: 这种昆虫生命周期很短。

definition_en: a child's word for father, or a warm informal name for one's father
core_image: 门口传来钥匙声，孩子立刻跑过去扑进父亲怀里
scene: 门锁一响，孩子立刻跑向门口。Dad came home late with bread.
sceneCN: 这里 Dad 指「爸爸」（第 1 个义项：孩子对父亲的称呼）；句意是爸爸很晚才带着面包回家。

senses.title: A child's word for father
senses.definition: the everyday name a young child uses for his or her father
senses.definitionCN: 幼小孩子称呼父亲的日常用词
senses.example: Dad came home late with bread.
senses.exampleCN: 爸爸很晚才带着面包回家。
senses.why: A small mouth needs a name it can say twice in one breath.
senses.whyCN: 小嘴巴需要一个能一口气说两遍的名字。

senses.title: A familiar name for one's father
senses.definition: a warm, informal way for a person of any age to speak of their father
senses.definitionCN: 任何年纪的人提到父亲时都可以用的亲切说法
senses.example: My dad still fixes my bike.
senses.exampleCN: 我老爹还给我修自行车。
senses.why: The nursery word grows up with the child and stays in the family.
senses.whyCN: 这个儿语词跟着孩子长大，留在了家里。

intro.en: Dad is a nursery word, first recorded in English in the fifteenth century; such words appear independently in many languages.
intro.cn: dad 是儿语词，英语文献中十五世纪已有记录；这类词在许多语言里各自独立出现。

items.en: Dad appears as a child's word for father.
items.cn: dad 作为孩子称呼父亲的词出现。

items.en: Some scholars link it to Welsh tad, father.
items.cn: 有学者把它和威尔士语的 tad（父亲）联系起来。

items.en: Dad spread from dialect speech into general use.
items.cn: dad 从方言口语扩展到通用说法。

items.en: Daddy became the nursery form, and dad the plainer one.
items.cn: daddy 成了儿语形式，dad 则是更朴素的那个。

items.en: Adults use dad as freely as children do.
items.cn: 成年人用起 dad 来和孩子一样自然。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short ad ending, and the meaning group names other words for a father.
note.cn: 形近组共享短促的 ad 结尾，近义组列出其他称呼父亲的说法。

entries.definition: to touch lightly with a cloth
a thick soft piece of material
a wall built to hold back water
the male parent
a very young child's word for father
entries.definitionCN: 极小的孩子对父亲的称呼

entries.definition: an old-fashioned or affectionate name for father
entries.definitionCN: 旧式或亲昵的父亲称呼

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a key turning in a door and end with the name a grown child still uses.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门锁转动开始，落到成年子女仍旧沿用的称呼。

normal.en: Dad is the first word many mouths learn to shout.
normal.cn: dad 是许多嘴巴学会喊的第一个词。

normal.en: Two soft d sounds, and the door opens.
normal.cn: 两个柔软的 d 音，门就开了。

normal.en: The word stays small even when the child grows tall.
normal.cn: 孩子长高了，这个词还是小小的。

normal.en: A dad joke is a joke told by the man who came home with bread.
normal.cn: 老爸的冷笑话，是那个带面包回家的人讲的。

normal.en: If a small child calls him, father becomes dad.
normal.cn: 如果小孩子喊他，父亲就成了爸爸。

abstract.en: Picture a child running at the sound of a key.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子听到钥匙声就冲过去。

abstract.en: Picture a pair of big shoes by the door.
abstract.cn: 想象门口放着一双大鞋。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting a small bike onto a stand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把小自行车架到支架上。

examples.en: Dad came home late with bread.
examples.cn: 爸爸很晚才带着面包回家。

examples.en: My dad still fixes my bike.
examples.cn: 我老爹还给我修自行车。

examples.en: Her dad taught her to swim.
examples.cn: 她爸爸教她游泳。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dad 记成「两个 d」：小嘴巴最容易发出的两个音，就是孩子喊爸爸的声音。

root: 是英语本土的儿语词，十五世纪已有记录；这类以重复音节构成的称呼在多种语言中各自独立产生，可能受威尔士语 tad（父亲）等影响。

sensesIntro.en: From a toddler's shout at the door, to the same word used by a grown son or daughter.
sensesIntro.cn: 从幼儿在门口的喊声，到成年子女仍旧使用的同一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a child running to the door when a key turns.
core.cn: 核心意象：钥匙一响，孩子就冲向门口。

branches.en: The first sense is the word a small child can say.
branches.cn: 第一个义项，是幼儿能说出的那个词。

branches.en: The same word keeps its warmth after the child grows up.
branches.cn: 孩子长大以后，这个词依然温热。

branches.en: Child and adult use one short word for the same man.
branches.cn: 孩子和大人，用同一个短词称呼同一个人。

branches.en: The family word outlives the nursery years.
branches.cn: 这个家庭用词，活得比童年更久。

branches.en: Calling him dad is itself a small act of closeness.
branches.cn: 叫他爸爸，本身就是一种亲近的小动作。

intro.en: Dad is a nursery word, and its family is built on the same two soft sounds.
intro.cn: dad 是儿语词，词族都建立在同样两个柔软的音上。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it is a native nursery form found in many languages.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，它是许多语言都有的本土儿语形式。

items.example: Dad is in the garden.
The dads waited at the gate.

items.meaning: a very young child's word for father
items.example: The baby called for daddy.
Two daddies waited outside.
Granddad told the same story again.
items.exampleCN: 爷爷又把同一个故事讲了一遍。

items.example: Her stepdad drove her to school.
items.exampleCN: 她的继父开车送她上学。

items.example: He told a terrible dad joke.
items.exampleCN: 他讲了一个糟糕的冷笑话。

items.meaning: a man whose child is not born yet
items.example: The dad-to-be painted the room.

definition_zh: 每日的；日常的；每天；日报
definition_en: happening every day, or a newspaper published every day
core_image: 桌上摊开一份当天的报纸和一杯热茶
scene: 清晨，她把当天的报纸摊在桌上，旁边放一杯热茶。She reads the daily paper with her tea.
sceneCN: 这里 daily 指「每日的」（第 1 个义项：每天都发生的）；句意是她一边喝茶一边读日报。

senses.title: Happening every day
senses.definition: done, happening, or produced every day
senses.definitionCN: 每天做、每天发生或每天产出的
senses.example: She reads the daily paper with her tea.
senses.exampleCN: 她一边喝茶一边读日报。
senses.why: What returns with the sun earns the name of the sun's round.
senses.whyCN: 跟着太阳回来的东西，就得到了太阳这一圈的名字。

senses.title: Every day
senses.definition: on every day, used as an adverb
senses.definitionCN: 在每一天，作副词使用
senses.example: He walks to the river daily.
senses.exampleCN: 他每天走到河边去。
senses.why: The adjective drops its ending and becomes the answer to how often.
senses.whyCN: 形容词去掉尾巴，就成了回答「多久一次」的词。

senses.title: A daily paper
senses.definition: a newspaper published every day
senses.definitionCN: 每天出版的报纸
senses.example: The daily arrived before seven.
senses.exampleCN: 日报七点前就送到了。
senses.why: A paper that keeps pace with the days becomes the day itself.
senses.whyCN: 跟着日子走的报纸，最后就成了「日子」本身。

intro.en: Daily is the Old English dæglic, from dæg, day, plus the suffix -lic, which became -ly.
intro.cn: daily 是古英语 dæglic，由 dæg（天）加后缀 -lic 构成，后者演变为 -ly。

items.en: Dæg meant the period of daylight or a whole day.
items.cn: dæg 指有日光的那段时间，或整整一天。

items.en: Dæglic meant belonging to a day.
items.cn: dæglic 意为属于一天的。

items.en: The form settled as daily, with the -ly ending.
items.cn: 形式固定为 daily，保留了 -ly 词尾。

items.en: Daily also named a paper printed each day.
items.cn: daily 也开始指每天印行的报纸。

items.en: It now covers routines, habits, and doses.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖日常流程、习惯与每日用量。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dai- shape, and the meaning group names things that keep returning.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dai- 外形，近义组列出不断重复出现的东西。

entries.definition: a place where milk is produced
a period of twenty-four hours
entries.definitionCN: 二十四小时的一段时间

entries.definition: to waste time slowly
ordinary and used each day
done as part of a fixed order
happening at fixed times

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a paper at breakfast and end with the same walk taken with the same sun.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从早餐时的一份报纸开始，落到同一个太阳下重复的那条路。

normal.en: Daily is day with an -ly coat on.
normal.cn: daily 就是 day 披上一件 -ly 的外套。

normal.en: A daily paper is the day printed on paper.
normal.cn: 日报，就是把这一天印在纸上。

normal.en: What you do daily, the body stops noticing.
normal.cn: 每天做的事，身体会渐渐不再察觉。

normal.en: The daily grind grinds because it comes back each morning.
normal.cn: 日常苦活之所以磨人，是因为它每天早上都回来。

normal.en: If it happens with every sunrise, it is daily.
normal.cn: 如果它每逢日出都发生，那就是每日的。

abstract.en: Picture a folded paper beside a steaming cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯冒热气的茶旁边放着一份折好的报纸。

abstract.en: Picture the same footprints freshened each morning.
abstract.cn: 想象同一些脚印每天早上重新出现。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar page torn away one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象日历一页一页被撕掉。

examples.en: She reads the daily paper with her tea.
examples.cn: 她一边喝茶一边读日报。

examples.en: He walks to the river daily.
examples.cn: 他每天走到河边去。

examples.en: Exercise should be part of daily life.
examples.cn: 锻炼应当成为日常生活的一部分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 daily 记成「天天」：day 是天，-ly 是天天的样子，天天看的那份报纸就是日报。

root: 源自古英语 dæglic，由 dæg（天）加后缀 -lic（后演变为 -ly）构成；本义是「属于每一天的」，后来兼指每天做的事与每天出版的报纸。

sensesIntro.en: From what returns every morning, to how often you do it, to the paper that arrives with it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从每天早上回来的事，到做它的频率，再到随之送到的报纸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same small round of tasks under the same sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个太阳下，同一小圈重复的事。

branches.en: The adjective marks what belongs to each day.
branches.cn: 形容词标出属于每一天的东西。

branches.en: The adverb answers how often the act is done.
branches.cn: 副词回答这个动作多久做一次。

branches.en: The noun is a paper that keeps the same pace.
branches.cn: 名词是跟着同样节奏出版的报纸。

branches.en: Daily life and doing something daily are the same rhythm.
branches.cn: 日常生活和每天做某事，是同一种节奏。

branches.en: The adverb and the newspaper both measure out the days.
branches.cn: 副词和报纸，都在给日子分格。

intro.en: Daily is a native English build on day, and its family keeps the same short root.
intro.cn: daily 是在 day 上用英语本土构词法搭出来的，词族共享同一个短词根。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it goes back to Old English dæg, day.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，它上溯到古英语 dæg（天）。

items.example: Daily practice helps.

items.meaning: a period of daylight or of hours
items.example: The day was warm.
It rained for three days.
Owls sleep in the daytime.
She handles day-to-day problems.
We stopped at midday.
These are my everyday shoes.

items.meaning: the food or money one needs each day
items.example: He works hard for his daily bread.
items.exampleCN: 他为了每日的口粮辛苦工作。

definition_en: a farm or place where milk is produced, a shop selling milk, or products made from milk
core_image: 清晨，奶牛排队走进挤奶棚，桶里冒着热气
scene: 清晨，奶牛排队走进挤奶棚，桶里冒着热气。The dairy sends fresh milk to the town each morning.
sceneCN: 这里 dairy 指「奶牛场」（第 1 个义项：生产牛奶的地方）；句意是这个奶牛场每天早上把鲜奶送到镇上。

senses.title: A milk farm
senses.definition: a farm or building where milk is produced and kept
senses.definitionCN: 生产并存放牛奶的农场或房屋
senses.example: The dairy sends fresh milk to the town each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这个奶牛场每天早上把鲜奶送到镇上。
senses.why: Milk must be collected in one place before it can travel.

senses.title: A milk shop
senses.definition: a shop that sells milk, butter, and cheese
senses.definitionCN: 出售牛奶、黄油和奶酪的店铺

senses.exampleCN: 他在乳品店买了黄油。
senses.why: Before fridges, milk had to be sold the same day it came.
senses.whyCN: 在没有冰箱的年代，奶得当天就卖掉。

senses.title: Made from milk
senses.definition: relating to milk or made from it, used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 与奶有关或用奶制成，用在名词前
senses.example: The dairy counter was full of cheese.
senses.exampleCN: 乳品柜台摆满了奶酪。
senses.why: A place word can turn into a label for what it sells.

intro.en: Dairy comes from Old English dæge, a woman servant, whose duties grew to include milking and making milk products.
intro.cn: dairy 源自古英语 dæge（女仆），她的活计逐渐包含挤奶和做奶制品。

items.en: Dæge named a woman servant in a household.
items.cn: dæge 指家里的女仆。

items.en: Her work came to include milking the cows.
items.cn: 她的活儿后来包括给奶牛挤奶。

items.en: Dey became the place where milk was worked.
items.cn: dey 变成处理牛奶的地方。

items.en: Dairy named both the room and the farm for milk.
items.cn: dairy 既指做奶的屋子，也指产奶的农场。

items.en: Dairy now also covers milk products and their industry.
items.cn: dairy 如今还涵盖乳制品及其行业。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dai- shape, and the meaning group names milk and the places that handle it.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dai- 外形，近义组列出牛奶与处理牛奶的场所。

a book for daily notes
a small white flower with a yellow centre
a place where milk is turned into butter

the act of taking milk from an animal
