normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with cows walking into a shed and end with a counter full of cheese.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从奶牛走进棚子开始，落到摆满奶酪的柜台。

normal.en: Dairy began as a woman's job and ended as a whole industry.
normal.cn: dairy 从一个女人的活计开始，最后成了一整个行业。

normal.en: Milk cannot wait, so the dairy must be near the cow.
normal.cn: 奶等不起，所以奶牛场得离牛很近。

normal.en: Dairy and diary differ by one letter and by a whole day.
normal.cn: dairy 和 diary 只差一个字母，也差着一整天的记录。

normal.en: A dairy counter is a farm seen through glass.
normal.cn: 乳品柜台，就是隔着玻璃看到的一座农场。

normal.en: If it comes from a cow and is white, it may be dairy.

abstract.cn: 想象一排奶牛在一道矮门前等着。

abstract.en: Picture a steel can of milk breathing steam.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钢桶里的牛奶冒着热气。

abstract.en: Picture a glass case of yellow butter blocks.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃柜里一块块黄色的黄油。

root: 源自古英语 dæge（女仆），她原先管揉面，后来也管挤奶与做奶制品；地方名 dey 逐渐演变为 dairy，指产奶、存奶与卖奶的场所。

sensesIntro.en: From the farm that produces milk, to the shop that sells it, to the label on the products themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: 从产奶的农场，到卖奶的店铺，再到奶制品本身的标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cows filing into a shed where milk is collected.
core.cn: 核心意象：奶牛排队走进收集牛奶的棚子。

branches.en: The first place is the farm or shed where milk is kept.
branches.cn: 最初的场所，是存放牛奶的农场或棚屋。

branches.en: The same word names the shop that sells the milk.
branches.cn: 同一个词也指卖奶的店铺。

branches.en: As a label it marks butter, cheese, and cream.
branches.cn: 作为标签，它标出黄油、奶酪和奶油。

branches.en: The farm and the shop are two ends of one route.
branches.cn: 农场和店铺，是同一条路的两端。

branches.en: A shop and its goods can share a single name.
branches.cn: 店铺和它的货物，可以共用一个名字。

intro.en: Dairy has a small English family, all of it tied to milk and to the work of producing it.
intro.cn: dairy 的英语词族不大，全都和牛奶以及产奶的活计有关。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it comes from Old English dæge, a woman servant.

The dairy cattle graze on the hill.
She chose a dairy-free dessert.
items.exampleCN: 她选了一份不含乳制品的甜点。

definition_zh: 水坝；拦河坝；阻拦之物；筑坝拦住
definition_en: a wall built across a river to hold back water, or to hold water or feeling back
core_image: 一道水泥墙把河拦腰截住，上游涨成一片湖
scene: 河水被一道水泥墙拦腰截住，上游涨成一片湖。They built a dam across the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 dam 指「水坝」（第 1 个义项：横在河上挡水的墙）；句意是他们在山谷里修了一座水坝。

senses.title: A wall across water
senses.definition: a wall built across a river to hold back water
senses.definitionCN: 横在河上用来挡水的墙
senses.example: They built a dam across the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在山谷里修了一座水坝。
senses.why: Water is stopped by the one thing it cannot flow through.
senses.whyCN: 水唯一流不过去的东西，就能把它挡住。

senses.title: A barrier of any kind
senses.definition: something that blocks a flow, like a heap of fallen trees
senses.definitionCN: 堵住流动的东西，例如一堆倒下的树
senses.example: A dam of fallen trees blocked the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 倒下的树堆成一道坝，堵住了小溪。
senses.why: Once a wall stops water, any wall can borrow the name.
senses.whyCN: 一旦有墙挡住了水，别的挡墙也能借用这个名字。

senses.title: To hold back
senses.definition: to stop water or a strong feeling from flowing out
senses.definitionCN: 阻止水或强烈情绪流出来
senses.example: She dammed up her tears until she got home.
senses.exampleCN: 她一直忍到回家才让眼泪流出来。
senses.why: Feelings can be held back the way a river is.
senses.whyCN: 情绪也能像河一样被拦在后面。

intro.en: Dam comes from Middle English, probably from Old Norse dammr or Middle Dutch dam, both naming a barrier that holds water.
intro.cn: dam 来自中古英语，可能出自古诺斯语 dammr 或中古荷兰语 dam，二者都指挡水的障碍。

items.en: Dammr named a barrier that held water back.
items.cn: dammr 指把水拦住的障碍。

items.en: Dam named a mound or wall closing a stream.
items.cn: dam 指堵住溪流的土堤或墙。

items.en: Dam entered English for a barrier across a river.
items.cn: dam 进入英语，指横在河上的障碍。

items.en: The verb dam meant to stop the water.
items.cn: 动词 dam 意为把水拦住。

items.en: Dam also covers blocked feelings and beaver works.
items.cn: dam 也用于被压抑的情绪和河狸筑的坝。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short dam- sound, and the meaning group names other barriers against water.
note.cn: 形近组共享短促的 dam- 音，近义组列出其他挡水的障碍。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a wall standing in a river and end with tears held back until home.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从立在河里的一道墙开始，落到忍到家才流的眼泪。

normal.en: A dam is a wall that decides how fast a river may leave.
normal.cn: 水坝是一道墙，决定河水能以多快的速度离开。

normal.en: Water gathers behind the wall and becomes a lake.
normal.cn: 水在墙后聚起来，就成了湖。

normal.en: Beavers have been building dams longer than people.
normal.cn: 河狸筑坝的历史，比人还长。

normal.en: When a dam bursts, the wall becomes the flood.
normal.cn: 坝一决口，那道墙就变成了洪水。

normal.en: If it holds something back, it is doing a dam's work.
normal.cn: 凡是把东西拦在后面的，都在干坝的活。

abstract.cn: 想象一道混凝土墙立在齐膝深的河里。

abstract.en: Picture a lake where a valley used to be.
abstract.cn: 想象一片湖，原本是一道山谷。

abstract.en: Picture a person pressing a hand to a shaking chest.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人用手按住发抖的胸口。

examples.cn: 他们在山谷里修了一座水坝。

examples.cn: 倒下的树堆成一道坝，堵住了小溪。

examples.en: She dammed up her tears until she got home.
examples.cn: 她一直忍到回家才让眼泪流出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dam 记成「挡」：一道墙挡在河中间，水过不去，就成了坝。

root: 来自中古英语，可能借自古诺斯语 dammr 或中古荷兰语 dam，本义是堵水的土堤或墙；先指拦河的坝，后引申为一切阻塞之物，以及压抑情绪的动作。

sensesIntro.en: From a wall in a river, to any heap that blocks a flow, to the act of holding something back.
sensesIntro.cn: 从河中的一道墙，到任何堵住流动的堆物，再到把东西拦在后面的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall standing across a river, with a lake behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道横在河里的墙，墙后积成一片湖。

branches.en: The basic shape is a wall set across moving water.
branches.cn: 最基本的形状，是横在流水上的一道墙。

branches.en: Any heap that stops a stream can take the name.
branches.cn: 任何堵住溪流的堆物都能用这个名字。

branches.en: The verb moves the wall inside, where feelings are held.
branches.cn: 动词把这道墙搬进身体里，用来拦住情绪。

branches.en: Concrete and fallen trees do the same work.
branches.cn: 混凝土和倒下的树，干的是同一件事。

branches.en: Stopping water and stopping tears are one gesture.
branches.cn: 拦住水和拦住眼泪，是同一个动作。

intro.en: Dam is a short borrowing with a narrow family, all of it about holding water or feeling back.
intro.cn: dam 是个短小的借词，词族很窄，全都关于拦住水或情绪。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin root; it came from Old Norse or Middle Dutch.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，它来自古诺斯语或中古荷兰语。

items.meaning: a wall that holds back water
items.example: The dam is very old.
The river has three dams.
The dammed river rose fast.
items.exampleCN: 被拦住的河水涨得很快。

items.meaning: the act of building a dam
items.example: Damming the stream killed the fish.
They dammed up the water.
A beaver dam crossed the creek.
items.exampleCN: 一道河狸坝横在小溪上。

items.example: The hydroelectric dam lights the town.
items.exampleCN: 这座水电站大坝为镇上供电。

items.meaning: the place chosen for a dam
items.example: Engineers visited the dam site.

definition_en: harm done to something, or to harm it
core_image: 冰雹在车顶砸出一片细小的坑
scene: 冰雹过后，车顶多了一片密密麻麻的小坑。The hail damaged every car on the street.
sceneCN: 这里 damaged 是 damage 的过去式，指「损坏」（第 2 个义项：使东西受损）；句意是冰雹砸坏了街上每一辆车。

senses.title: Harm done to a thing
senses.definition: physical harm that makes something less useful or sound
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变得不好用或不完整的实体损伤
senses.example: The storm caused damage to the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨给屋顶造成了损坏。
senses.why: A thing is damaged when it can no longer do its job.
senses.whyCN: 当一个东西干不了它的活，它就是被损坏了。

senses.title: To harm something
senses.definition: to harm something or make it worse
senses.definitionCN: 伤害某物或使其状况变差
senses.example: The hail damaged every car on the street.
senses.exampleCN: 冰雹砸坏了街上每一辆车。
senses.why: Damage is what the blow leaves behind on the surface.
senses.whyCN: 损坏，就是那一击在表面上留下的东西。

senses.title: Money paid for harm
senses.definition: money paid to repair or make up for harm, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 为修复或弥补损害而支付的钱，通常用复数
senses.example: The court ordered him to pay damages.
senses.exampleCN: 法院命令他支付赔偿金。
senses.why: When a thing cannot be mended, money is asked to stand in for it.
senses.whyCN: 东西修不好时，就请钱来代替它。

intro.en: Damage comes from Latin damnum, loss or cost, through Old French damage.
intro.cn: damage 源自拉丁语 damnum（损失、代价），经古法语 damage 进入英语。

items.en: Damnum meant loss, cost, or harm.
items.cn: damnum 意为损失、代价或伤害。

items.en: Damnare meant to cause a loss or condemn.
items.cn: damnare 意为使受损失或宣判。

items.en: Damage named harm and the loss it caused.
items.cn: damage 指伤害以及它带来的损失。

items.en: Damage entered English for injury to property.
items.cn: damage 进入英语，指对财物的损伤。

items.en: The plural damages named money paid in law.
items.cn: 复数 damages 指法律上支付的赔偿金。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dam- opening, and the meaning group names other kinds of harm.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dam- 开头，近义组列出其他形式的伤害。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with hail on a car roof and end with a court order to pay.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从砸在车顶的冰雹开始，落到法院的赔付命令。

normal.en: Damage is the bill the world sends after a blow.
normal.cn: 损坏，是世界在打击之后寄来的账单。

normal.en: A thing is damaged when it stops doing what it was made for.
normal.cn: 东西做不了它原本该做的事，就是损坏了。

normal.en: Reputation can be damaged without a single broken object.
normal.cn: 名声可以被损害，却一件东西都没碎。

normal.en: When repair is impossible, damages are money in its place.
normal.cn: 修不好时，赔偿金就是代替它的钱。

normal.en: If it costs something to fix, there was damage.
normal.cn: 如果修它要花钱，那就是有过损坏。

abstract.en: Picture a car roof covered in small round dents.
abstract.cn: 想象车顶布满一个个小圆坑。

abstract.en: Picture a cracked window that still keeps out rain.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇裂了却还能挡雨的窗。

abstract.en: Picture a folded paper with a sum written at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折起来的纸，末尾写着一个数额。

examples.en: The storm caused damage to the roof.
examples.cn: 暴风雨给屋顶造成了损坏。

examples.en: The hail damaged every car on the street.
examples.cn: 冰雹砸坏了街上每一辆车。

examples.en: The court ordered him to pay damages.
examples.cn: 法院命令他支付赔偿金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 damage 记成「打折」：东西被打折了，就是受了损；修不好，就用钱来赔。

root: 源自拉丁语 damnum（损失、代价），经古法语 damage 进入英语；本义是让人遭受损失，先指财物的损伤，后指法律上为弥补损失而支付的赔偿金。

sensesIntro.en: From the harm a blow leaves, to the act of harming, to the money that stands in for what was lost.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一击留下的损伤，到使人受损的动作，再到代替损失的那笔钱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hard blow landing on a surface and leaving a mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一次重击落在表面上，留下痕迹。

branches.en: The noun names the harm itself.
branches.cn: 名词指伤害本身。

branches.en: The verb names the act that produces it.
branches.cn: 动词指造成它的那个动作。

branches.en: The plural turns the harm into a sum of money.
branches.cn: 复数把伤害变成一笔钱。

branches.en: The harm and the harming are two sides of one event.
branches.cn: 损伤与造成损伤，是同一件事的两面。

branches.en: What cannot be repaired is paid for instead.
branches.cn: 修不好的部分，就用钱来抵。

intro.en: Damage belongs to the Latin damnum family, where loss turns into harm and into money paid.
intro.cn: damage 属于拉丁语 damnum 这一族，「损失」在这里变成伤害与赔款。

latinIntro.en: The Latin damnum, loss, and damnare, to condemn, stand behind this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 damnum（损失）与 damnare（宣判）是这一族词的根。

items.example: The old tale warned of damnation.

definition_en: to condemn someone, to swear at something, or a word showing strong feeling
core_image: 一脚踩进泥坑，低声吐出一句骂
scene: 他一脚踩进泥坑，低声骂了一句。He damned the driver who splashed him.
sceneCN: 这里 damned 是 damn 的过去式，指「咒骂」（第 1 个义项：用狠话骂人）；句意是他咒骂那个溅了他一身水的司机。

pos.zh: 丝毫；一点点（多用于否定）

senses.title: To condemn or swear at
senses.definition: to condemn someone or swear at something in anger
senses.definitionCN: 愤怒地谴责某人或咒骂某事
senses.example: He damned the driver who splashed him.
senses.exampleCN: 他咒骂那个溅了他一身水的司机。
senses.why: The word began as a judgement and ended as a shout.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从审判开始，最后变成一声喊。

senses.title: An angry exclamation
senses.definition: a short angry word used when something goes wrong
senses.definitionCN: 事情出错时脱口而出的短促气话
senses.example: Damn, I left the keys inside.
senses.exampleCN: 该死，我把钥匙落在里面了。
senses.why: When a plan breaks, the mouth reaches for the strongest word it has.
senses.whyCN: 计划一碎，嘴就去抓它最有力的那个词。

senses.title: Not a bit
senses.definition: a very small amount, used in negative statements
senses.definitionCN: 极少的量，多用于否定句
senses.example: He does not care a damn.
senses.exampleCN: 他一点也不在乎。
senses.why: The least valuable thing you can name becomes the measure of nothing.
senses.whyCN: 能说出的最不值钱的东西，就成了「零」的度量。

intro.en: Damn comes from Latin damnare, to condemn, from damnum, loss, through Old French damner.
intro.cn: damn 源自拉丁语 damnare（宣判有罪），其根为 damnum（损失），经古法语 damner 进入英语。

items.en: Damnum meant loss or harm.
items.cn: damnum 意为损失或伤害。

items.en: Damnare meant to condemn to loss or punishment.
items.cn: damnare 意为判处损失或刑罚。

items.en: Damner carried the sense of condemning a soul.
items.cn: damner 带有判灵魂有罪的意思。

items.en: Damn entered English for eternal punishment.
items.cn: damn 进入英语，指永罚。

items.en: It softened into a common swear word and an intensifier.
items.cn: 它软化成常见的骂人话和加强语气的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dam- sound, and the meaning group names other ways of condemning.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dam- 的读音，近义组列出其他谴责的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a foot in the mud and end with a care that amounts to nothing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一脚踩进泥里开始，落到一份少到等于没有的在乎。

normal.en: Damn began in court and ended in the street.
normal.cn: damn 从法庭出发，最后落在了街上。

normal.en: A slipped foot is enough to make the word appear.
normal.cn: 脚下一滑，就够让这个词冒出来。

normal.en: The strongest word loses strength each time it is used.
normal.cn: 最狠的词，每用一次就弱一分。

normal.en: Not caring a damn is caring the smallest possible amount.
normal.cn: 一点也不在乎，就是只在乎那么一丁点。

normal.en: When words fail, damn is what the mouth finds.
normal.cn: 话不够用时，嘴就找到了 damn。

abstract.en: Picture a clean shoe sinking into dark mud.
abstract.cn: 想象一只干净的鞋陷进黑泥里。

abstract.en: Picture a hand slapping a table once, hard.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手重重拍了一下桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a scale with nothing at all on it.
abstract.cn: 想象一台秤上什么也没放。

examples.en: He damned the driver who splashed him.
examples.cn: 他咒骂那个溅了他一身水的司机。

examples.en: Damn, I left the keys inside.
examples.cn: 该死，我把钥匙落在里面了。

examples.en: He does not care a damn.
examples.cn: 他一点也不在乎。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 damn 记成「判」：原本是宣判有罪，后来变成一句脱口而出的骂。

root: 源自拉丁语 damnare（宣判有罪），出自 damnum（损失），经古法语 damner 进入英语；本义是判定某人该受惩罚，后弱化为咒骂与表示恼怒的感叹词。

sensesIntro.en: From a solemn judgement, to a street-corner swear, to a measure of utter indifference.
sensesIntro.cn: 从庄重的判决，到街角的骂声，再到衡量彻底不在乎的量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand striking a table after something goes wrong.
core.cn: 核心意象：事情出错后，一只手重重拍在桌上。

branches.en: The oldest sense is a judgement that condemns.
branches.cn: 最古老的意思，是宣判有罪的裁断。

branches.en: The same word becomes a short cry when things break.
branches.cn: 事情崩了时，同一个词变成一声短喊。

branches.en: In the negative it measures how little one cares.
branches.cn: 在否定句里，它衡量一个人有多不在乎。

branches.en: A curse and a cry of anger come from one root.
branches.cn: 诅咒和怒喊，出自同一个根。

branches.en: A word of anger can also measure nothing at all.
branches.cn: 一句怒气话，也能用来衡量「什么都没有」。

intro.en: Damn belongs to the Latin damnum family, where loss grows into judgement and into swearing.
intro.cn: damn 属于拉丁语 damnum 这一族，「损失」在这里长成审判与骂声。

latinIntro.en: The Latin damnare, to condemn, is the root under damn and damnation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 damnare（宣判有罪）是 damn 与 damnation 的根。

items.example: They damned the plan as foolish.
items.exampleCN: 他们谴责这个计划愚蠢。

items.example: He damns every delay.
That damned noise never stops.
items.exampleCN: 那该死的噪音一刻不停。

items.example: The letter was damning evidence.
The old tale warned of damnation.
items.exampleCN: 那个古老的故事警告人会有永罚。

items.example: It was a damnable mistake.
Damn it, the bus has gone.
She does not give a damn about it.
items.exampleCN: 她一点也不在乎这件事。
